On the POS, a new sale can use an eligible table or a named check without a table, when supported and open checks are enabled. A physical table keeps its own service session, covers and seats; a check without a table does not create them. Guest QR ordering retains its table/session requirements. Pickup Enable pickup in the restaurant settings, then check the offered date/time and preparation delay. The customer collects at the configured location. Delivery Require a usable delivery address and check zone, fee and fulfillment window. A delivery day can be saved before its final time window is confirmed. Scheduled and batch orders Review ordering windows, cutoff and fulfillment dates. With a batch calendar, use the restaurant-defined cycle instead of inventing a free date. Choose a stage attachment In Admin, open Settings → Restaurant → Order workflow and the required pickup or delivery stage. With Notify customer enabled, choose the message type, an approved Meta photo/PDF model and its attachment: a fixed file, or that order’s receipt for a PDF. Choose the sending time and save the workflow. Manual stage entry or its configured event uses this binding. Selecting a file changes neither progression, payment rules nor delivery eligibility. Correct an incompatible or missing model/file before relying on delivery. The model library and creation controls are in Settings → Communications → WhatsApp. Follow an assigned delivery’s departure When the assigned courier starts their route in Admin, unfinished accepted, preparing and ready delivery orders change together to Out for delivery. Staff screens receive the updated statuses through their usual order refresh. This confirms actual departure; assigning a courier or choosing a fulfillment mode alone does not start a route. Held kitchen courses and unsettled weight orders must be resolved first. If starting fails, the previous statuses remain. The route action does not reopen finished or cancelled orders. Make a one-order combo exception For a one-order combo exception, an authorized Admin user opens the combo step and selects Choose another item. The replacement is included without a surcharge and is saved on that order only. Fulfillment, scheduling and delivery rules remain unchanged. Review the selected dish and portion in the order details. Guest and POS combo pickers retain the configured composition; arrange an exception through the internal Admin order editor. See the combo guide for quantities, eligibility and recovery. Wait for counter card payment before kitchen preparation For a new counter pickup order paid by card, choose Pay, then Pay by card. Wait for terminal approval and for Foody to record the payment before preparation and the kitchen ticket start. During collection the payment remains pending and is excluded from the live order board. After a refusal or cancellation, keep the same checkout and retry there; do not send it to the kitchen to bypass payment. If approval succeeded but synchronization failed, reconcile the existing payment before starting another charge. Orders deliberately sent for table service before collection keep their existing send-then-pay flow. Use the original series stock pool Predefined item stocks now have a journal under Items & menus → Stock history and on each product. A rotating carte can prepare initial allowances per series and publish them without restoring already committed units. Previous remaining counts are not carried forward. Order changes and pre-production releases use the original frozen pool; a produced item remains consumed. Ingredient/preparation quantities and recipe costs remain separate. See Availability for initial imports, corrections and history filters. Staff contact details and courier destination Staff contact details are managed in Admin → Staff → employee → Edit contact details. The restaurant-scoped name and phone are used for courier assignment and upcoming delivery reminders; the sign-in email remains read-only. Couriers can save a default final destination or link it to their home address. New routes propose that destination and allow an explicit override or removal. It is the courier’s end-of-route destination, separate from the customer’s delivery address. Existing populated routes and completed delivery snapshots keep their saved data. See staff profiles for saving, permissions and recovery. Recover a delivery after a test departure Starting courier mode marks assigned orders Out for delivery. If this was a test departure, a user with order-management permission can open Orders → Deliveries, select the date and choose Undo departure while no arrival, delivery or skipped stop has been recorded. Out for delivery orders return to In preparation; the route returns to draft and can be unassigned and reallocated. This is a delivery correction, not a new order, refund or reprint. Payments and previously sent messages are preserved. See the dispatch procedure. Check conditional item choices An item configured with repeated positions requires one separate choice per position according to the selected format. For example, a two-character Number Cake accepts 11, AB or A7. The format price replaces the base price; modifiers add only their configured surcharges. Reducing the position count removes newly hidden choices. Positions remain distinct in the cart, orders and kitchen ticket; review them before confirming. These customizations do not change delivery, availability, recipe, discount or cancellation rules. Configuration requires compatible versions and menu editing permission. See Variants and sizes for setup and recovery after a rejected selection. Open a dine-in check without a table Requires compatible API/POS versions, orders.manage and open checks enabled for this POS mode. Select Dine-In for a new unassigned sale; this does not yet open a table or check. Complete any customer prompt and enter the items. At Send/Continue, choose Save check → New check → Custom check once: the name form opens directly, including when predefined names are enabled without a configured group. Enter the name, then Save. Back returns to destination selection without creating a check and preserves the source basket. The explicit Send then continues once with the fresh lines. A destination change during Pay does not automatically collect money: review and initiate payment explicitly. Cancel preserves the source basket. You can also create the empty check first from Actions → Open tickets → New ticket, select Dine-In, then choose its group/name or custom name. This standalone flow retains configured groups and available names: choosing a name creates the check, while a custom name needs Save. This is real onsite consumption, not renamed pickup. Further sends keep one bill and create separate kitchen batches. Payment, preparation and closing remain separate; close only with no unsent items or unpaid live batches. Saved orders remain in Orders on POS and Admin. No artificial table/session, covers or numbered seats are created. Financial splitting or moving this named check to a table is not supported here. An uncertain creation keeps its request identity: Retry the same request instead of creating another check. Choose the method for the whole POS check For an unsent sale, open Actions → Fulfillment methods in the check, tap the intended row in Select fulfillment for this order . The current method is highlighted with a green Selected badge. Tapping a row continues immediately, without a separate Save button; closing before choosing leaves the sale unchanged. This is the check's overall method, not a choice for the selected item. Choices come from the restaurant's POS fulfillment settings. Items without an explicit choice follow the check; items with their own preparation choice keep it. Once the check is sent, its recorded overall method is retained. A table check remains attached to its table/session and a named check retains its dine-in, pickup or delivery type; the method selector is not a table-transfer, check-merge or financial-split tool. If the method requests customer information, confirm the optional name/phone form too; cancelling it cancels the staged mode choice. The Client tab shows the recorded contact. See customer information. For a new onsite sale, choose the method and any customer details before adding items; the table/check is requested only at Send/Continue. Save check provides search, sorting and sections. Choose an existing unpaid onsite check with no other unsent lines, or New check → section → free table. Required covers are requested only after that table choice. New check → Custom check or a configured group/name creates a named onsite check without a physical table, requiring open checks enabled and the matching API. A retry retains one creation identity; an uncertain response freezes that request. Cancellation keeps the source basket. An existing destination retains its customer, discounts and saved lines; only fresh lines become the next kitchen batch. Paid, pending-payment, allocated, uncertain-total or conflicting-customer checks are rejected without moving the source. Explicitly remove a source check-level discount before changing destination. A changed destination during Pay does not automatically charge: review it and initiate payment explicitly. For a sale already attached to a table without financial splitting, the normal flow uses its sole allowed method directly instead of showing a one-row choice. If that method requests customer information, its form still appears and must be completed or skipped; cancellation retains the draft. This simplification does not apply to counter sales, named or financial checks, or when multiple methods are available. Explicitly opening Actions → Fulfillment methods keeps the selector, even with one option. Start an onsite sale without a method prompt On compatible API/POS versions, turn off the staff fulfillment prompt and keep the intended onsite method first among the enabled methods in Admin. Start a new sale in Menu: that enabled default applies without selecting Takeaway merely because no table has been chosen yet. If customer details are configured for the method, its optional form still applies. With courses enabled, the first configured named course receives ordinary new items; items from the configured immediate-send library categories use Straight fire. An explicit later course choice remains selected. Add the items, then tap Send, or Continue when the mode offers it. Save check asks for the real destination: select an eligible existing onsite check, or New check → section → free table. Open checks enabled also permits a supported named check without a table; disabling that module does not disable sending an onsite sale to a physical table. Cancelling the destination preserves the draft and sends nothing. Saved checks retain their recorded method, and restoring a draft does not replace an explicit method choice with a newly changed default. A new-sale reset clears only that sale’s provisional course/hold/fire choices, not another open check. Review the destination before any payment; choosing it does not collect automatically. Give one item a different preparation instruction In the item sheet's Options → Fulfillment methods , choose an enabled method and confirm the item with Done . For example, an item marked takeaway in a dine-in check indicates how that item should be prepared or packed; it does not move the check away from its table. Selecting Delivery on one line does not create another delivery, recipient, address, charge or courier task. Use a separate Delivery order when goods must actually go to another destination. Staff POS customer name/phone remain optional; this form does not require a street/city address. Guest online ordering retains its own delivery validation. The available methods are restaurant-wide; there is no separate matrix of allowed item choices for each parent service. These choices do not change printer assignments or category rules: verify printer routing separately. Change an unassigned draft's service safely An unpaid, wholly unsent anonymous draft can change pickup/delivery lifecycle or be assigned to an eligible onsite destination at Send/Continue. Empty destinations keep their own table/session identity. A saved, unpaid, unsplit onsite check can accept fresh lines only if it has no other unsent work, confirmed totals and a compatible guest snapshot; its saved lines, customer and discount policy remain unchanged. No paid/pending, allocated, uncertain or conflicting destination is overwritten. A source check-level discount must be removed explicitly before moving to a table/named check; do not silently discard or transfer that policy. On cancellation or a changed restaurant, permission, configuration, source or target, keep the source and review the error instead of recreating or paying for the same food twice. Source consumption occurs only after the destination local draft is confirmed. The explicit Send continues once after a successful choice; changing destination in Pay requires another explicit payment initiation. Table services with financial allocations are not silently converted by this flow. Keep private guest context on the check In the customer screen offered after fulfillment selection, first name, last name, guest identifier and note describe the whole check, not an item or a separate delivery. These details remain staff-only and are retained across successive sends on that check. They do not create a customer account and are not included in public tracking/payment responses or notification variables. Private fields require a compatible API version; if the POS requests an update, retain the check and have the server updated before continuing, without repeating a payment. Control weekly ordering manually Weekly batch restaurants can choose Manual opening under Settings → Ordering & delivery → Orders & availability, with settings.edit. Save, then explicitly open or pause online orders using the pause control. Automatic opening/cutoff times do not control intake in this mode. Delivery days/windows, the restaurant timezone, preparation and stock rules remain in effect; existing orders are untouched. The website stays browsable during a pause. Active temporary test access must be disabled before reopening publicly. See the fulfillment settings guide for the complete procedure.

articles.title: Preorders, slots and batch cycles
articles.description: Admin → Settings → Order taking → Preorders
articles.body: Admin → Settings → Order taking → Preorders Choose the intake policy Select whether preordering is disabled, offered alongside other orders, or required using the offered policy controls. Check enabled pickup/delivery services separately. Configure date/time slots Choose the slot calendar and set offered lead time, horizon and fulfillment windows. Test boundary dates in the preview rather than assuming all calendar dates are available. Configure a batch cycle Set ordering opening, cutoff and fulfillment days/windows for the cycle. Review pickup and delivery windows separately and inspect the generated cycle preview. Check payment and product exceptions Review the prepayment policy and product-specific exceptions. Save, reopen settings and test the published guest path without making a live payment as a test. Open the current weekly batch automatically For a restaurant configured for weekly batches, open Home or Orders using the Série date basis. The current batch is selected by default even without orders; its totals then stay at zero. It advances after the previous batch’s final fulfillment day in the restaurant timezone, without waiting for the first order or for ordering to open. An open page follows this change on the next automatic refresh (about one minute) or when you return to the tab. You can select an older service in the calendar; that selection stays in place while the page is open. An order for a later week does not replace the current batch as the default. A payment-attention link keeps its explicit period. If the date looks incorrect, check the configured fulfillment days and restaurant timezone, then reload. Rollover does not create an order or publish a menu. Control weekly ordering manually Weekly batch restaurants can choose Manual opening under Settings → Ordering & delivery → Orders & availability, with settings.edit. Save, then explicitly open or pause online orders using the pause control. Automatic opening/cutoff times do not control intake in this mode. Delivery days/windows, the restaurant timezone, preparation and stock rules remain in effect; existing orders are untouched. The website stays browsable during a pause. Active temporary test access must be disabled before reopening publicly. See the fulfillment settings guide for the complete procedure.

articles.title: Production quantities and packing
articles.description: Admin → Orders → Production / POS → Scheduled calendar
articles.body: Admin → Orders → Production / POS → Scheduled calendar Select the service date Select the intended service/date and inspect included orders. Compare quantities with the same date basis used by Orders and the dashboard. Review item and portion quantities Review aggregated items, variants, portions and notes before assigning preparation. Recheck the plan after a saved order change. Prepare customer packing Use the customer/order breakdown to organize packing and pickup/delivery handover. Confirm completed preparation with the offered controls; preparation does not confirm payment.

articles.title: Split and recombine bills
articles.description: Open the saved table bill → Actions → Split. Choose by cover, item or equal parts where available.
articles.body: Open the saved table bill → Actions → Split. Choose by cover, item or equal parts where available. Availability and access Advanced actions appear only when the installed POS and API advertise the required capability and your role permits them. Refresh a changed bill before retrying; never create another charge to resolve an uncertain result. Take cash for a split bill After saving the split, select the exact financial bill and verify its amount. Cash collection requires the same enrolled POS to have an open cash drawer session; the confirmed amount is recorded for that bill and drawer. A claimed cash payment with an unknown outcome must be resolved before the drawer can close. Do not merge or move a bill to work around a pending payment, and do not make a second cash sale for a timeout. Allocate covers or items By cover creates bills for assigned guests with items and shares multi-guest items. Table items and unused covers remain on the original. By item lets you select and assign items; equal parts divides the selected amount. The displayed plan remains provisional until Save. Share selected items Select complete items then Share item(s). Choose equal or custom parts and enter the count or amounts. Complete the exact selected total; review each bill, reductions, fees and covers before Save. Custom item amounts allocate food value and do not collect a payment. Recombine saved fractions Return every unpaid part of the same original unit to its original bill/ledger anchor, then use Regroup when offered. Paid, missing, actively claimed or mixed offered/charged parts cannot be regrouped. Regroup before subdividing a saved fraction again. Back/Discard leaves the saved plan unchanged. Check variant details before allocating An item’s allocation details retain its variant choices by position. Check the characters and their order before allocating; they add no surcharge to the already recorded amount. Sharing rules and production quantities remain unchanged.

articles.title: Take an order on the POS
articles.description: How to open a table or start a counter order, add items with modifiers, and send to the kitchen.
articles.body: POS → Tables / Order entry. Whole-check method/contact dialogs and tableless dine-in require compatible POS and API versions. Updating the API alone does not add these controls to an older installed POS. Confirm the whole check’s method and contact Before the first send, confirm Actions → Fulfillment methods. If enabled, the optional name/phone form belongs to the whole check: Save confirms it, Cancel preserves the draft. All its kitchen courses share the saved contact; later sends retain coherent existing details, not those of a selected ticket. Item preparation choices create no extra customer or delivery. See whole-check selection and customer information. Mode selection and any customer prompt precede items in a new onsite sale. The table/check is chosen only at Send/Continue; cancellation preserves the source. See whole-check fulfillment. Private guest context is staff-only, never a public checkout answer or notification variable. Prepare this POS for cash collection Before collecting cash for a table or counter order, start your PIN shift and open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance on this enrolled device. Enter the physical opening float, then select the right order, tap Pay and record the cash actually received. If a collection times out, reconcile or retry the retained request instead of creating a second sale. A card payment uses the terminal flow and is not cash in the drawer. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Start the intended check Choose the table or counter order and verify the active check, service and employee. Opening an already open table resumes its existing session and check without requesting covers again; the guest-count prompt belongs to starting a new occupation, not reopening one. Existing separated checks retain their own balances and require an explicit bill choice where offered. A paid QR order still belongs to its guest: opening the table does not merge or collect that payment again. See the live table workflow. Add and customize items Choose a visible POS menu group, item, active variant and allowed modifiers. Review quantity, notes and price before adding. Required choices must be completed. Assign seats and courses Where enabled, assign the item to a seat, shared table or course before sending. These preparation assignments are distinct from later financial bill splitting. Send and verify preparation Review pending items and use the configured kitchen-send action. Check the saved order and kitchen result; printer success and order persistence are separate outcomes. Resume or collect payment Reopen the saved check to add items or start payment. Confirm the selected check and unpaid balance before charging; do not resend already-sent food. Choose a stage attachment In Admin, open Settings → Restaurant → Order workflow and the required pickup or delivery stage. With Notify customer enabled, choose the message type, an approved Meta photo/PDF model and its attachment: a fixed file, or that order’s receipt for a PDF. Choose the sending time and save the workflow. Manual stage entry or its configured event uses this binding. Selecting a file changes neither progression, payment rules nor delivery eligibility. Correct an incompatible or missing model/file before relying on delivery. The model library and creation controls are in Settings → Communications → WhatsApp. Follow an assigned delivery’s departure When the assigned courier starts their route in Admin, unfinished accepted, preparing and ready delivery orders change together to Out for delivery. Staff screens receive the updated statuses through their usual order refresh. This confirms actual departure; assigning a courier or choosing a fulfillment mode alone does not start a route. Held kitchen courses and unsettled weight orders must be resolved first. If starting fails, the previous statuses remain. The route action does not reopen finished or cancelled orders. Make a one-order combo exception For a one-order combo exception, an authorized Admin user opens the combo step and selects Choose another item. The replacement is included without a surcharge and is saved on that order only. Fulfillment, scheduling and delivery rules remain unchanged. Review the selected dish and portion in the order details. Guest and POS combo pickers retain the configured composition; arrange an exception through the internal Admin order editor. See the combo guide for quantities, eligibility and recovery. Wait for counter card payment before kitchen preparation For a new counter pickup order paid by card, choose Pay, then Pay by card. Wait for terminal approval and for Foody to record the payment before preparation and the kitchen ticket start. During collection the payment remains pending and is excluded from the live order board. After a refusal or cancellation, keep the same checkout and retry there; do not send it to the kitchen to bypass payment. If approval succeeded but synchronization failed, reconcile the existing payment before starting another charge. Orders deliberately sent for table service before collection keep their existing send-then-pay flow. Use published carte structure and live stock Predefined item stocks now have a journal under Items & menus → Stock history and on each product. A rotating carte can prepare initial allowances per series and publish them without restoring already committed units. Previous remaining counts are not carried forward. Order changes and pre-production releases use the original frozen pool; a produced item remains consumed. Ingredient/preparation quantities and recipe costs remain separate. See Availability for initial imports, corrections and history filters. Staff contact details and courier destination Staff contact details are managed in Admin → Staff → employee → Edit contact details. The restaurant-scoped name and phone are used for courier assignment and upcoming delivery reminders; the sign-in email remains read-only. Couriers can save a default final destination or link it to their home address. New routes propose that destination and allow an explicit override or removal. It is the courier’s end-of-route destination, separate from the customer’s delivery address. Existing populated routes and completed delivery snapshots keep their saved data. See staff profiles for saving, permissions and recovery. Recover a delivery after a test departure Starting courier mode marks assigned orders Out for delivery. If this was a test departure, a user with order-management permission can open Orders → Deliveries, select the date and choose Undo departure while no arrival, delivery or skipped stop has been recorded. Out for delivery orders return to In preparation; the route returns to draft and can be unassigned and reallocated. This is a delivery correction, not a new order, refund or reprint. Payments and previously sent messages are preserved. See the dispatch procedure. Check conditional item choices An item configured with repeated positions requires one separate choice per position according to the selected format. For example, a two-character Number Cake accepts 11, AB or A7. The format price replaces the base price; modifiers add only their configured surcharges. Reducing the position count removes newly hidden choices. Positions remain distinct in the cart, orders and kitchen ticket; review them before confirming. These customizations do not change delivery, availability, recipe, discount or cancellation rules. Configuration requires compatible versions and menu editing permission. See Variants and sizes for setup and recovery after a rejected selection. Take an order on the mobile terminal On the updated terminal, open Checks with the bottom receipt icon. Its selector offers All checks or a floor plan. Open a table, then, if prompted, choose the guest count or No covers; Back cancels that choice. The sale combines Menu, Check and Actions. Menu retains search and menu selection; with courses enabled, choose a course in the bottom strip before adding an item. A new item guides outstanding choice groups. On the terminal, even a simple item without variants or modifiers opens Seat when seats are enabled, at least one cover is recorded and no individual seat is preselected, except where quick entry is explicitly configured. Quick entry keeps its policy without bypassing a required seat. With seats disabled, a seat already selected or on iPad, this new condition does not force an extra panel. A valid required single choice advances; multiple-choice groups finish explicitly with Next or Done at the top. The counter shows progress through groups. In Seat, Table occupies the first row; selecting it returns to the summary. Seats and Add seat remain below; multiple-seat assignment still requires Done. On both mobile and iPad, the Add/Extra/No palette appears only when Use conversational modifiers in POS is enabled for the group; when off, only values appear. This is separate from the item’s quick-entry setting. With the palette enabled, tap a verb then an ingredient: the verb disarms after that one ingredient, and chips preserve entry order in a scrolling row. On the side, No and Extra remain distinct actions. Reopening a field does not restart the guide. Review note, quantity and price, then Add; an existing line uses Done. Closing discards the addition. The handle returns to checks without clearing the draft, including after a read error. Send and fire/hold follow permissions and the service mode; animation does not prove physical printing. Check retains Pay and the ⋯ menu. Older installed versions keep their earlier presentation. Actions → Details → Guest displays recorded contact information. group setting and refresh.

articles.title: Understand a cash-drawer access refusal
articles.description: On the affected POS, open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance or Cash movements. This diagnostic needs compatible POS and API versions; this guide does not confirm installation.
articles.body: On the affected POS, open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance or Cash movements. This diagnostic needs compatible POS and API versions; this guide does not confirm installation. Release availability must be confirmed This application exists in the source workspace. This guide does not confirm public distribution or availability in your installed release. Review the refusal without replacing the shift or drawer If Cash drawer balance or Cash movements cannot confirm the drawer, this does not confirm that no drawer is open. Use Retry to read the state again on the same device. While the read fails, no new opening, cash adjustment or closure is allowed, even if an older report remains displayed. After a successful read, actions return according to the confirmed state and your permissions. A specific message may ask you to check the PIN sign-in or open shift, have the device authorization reviewed, or verify an installation that does not match the open shift. Have a manager or support examine this relationship without blindly changing hours or assignments. Do not re-enroll the device or create a replacement shift or drawer to bypass the refusal. The message repairs no relationship and does not by itself identify another physical device. Temporarily unavailable verification can be retried; it proves neither a network outage nor a missing reference. An older POS or API may still display a generic message. An already pending operation retains its existing recovery with the same identifier; do not recreate it or erase local data. An absent session must be confirmed by the API’s business response, not inferred from a connection, access or missing-route error. Keep physical cash and the Verifone terminal separate Retry creates no cash movement and starts no Verifone deposit. Cash drawer balance needs access to the Foody API, not a connected Victa Mini. Card payments and operations sent to the terminal use their own connection and remain separate. Cards are excluded: closing cash does not start a Verifone deposit, and a Verifone deposit does not close cash. Never use a cash adjustment to disguise a card refund. Reconfirm the context before a terminal deposit On a compatible POS, a Terminal deposits confirmation belongs to the restaurant, staff sign-in and terminal configuration shown when it opened. If any changes before confirmation, the old dialog must not launch an action in the new context. Reopen Terminal deposits, check the terminal and its available capabilities, then explicitly confirm the intended action. Old results are not a confirmed state for the new context. If a command had already been transmitted, changing screens or restaurants does not cancel it: check the original terminal or provider before repeating anything and preserve pending operations. This protection closes neither physical cash nor the staff period and does not certify a physical deposit on a particular device.

articles.title: Understanding payment status
articles.description: Check confirmed payments and handle uncertain results safely.
articles.body: Open the corresponding Foody workspace described below. Refund or void a Verifone online payment In Admin → Orders, open the order and its payment section. An owner or manager with payments.manage can use Refund or void payment for a single verified ILS Verifone online sale or confirmed capture. Table/session, mixed tenders, partial collections, external-terminal payments and catering deposits are not supported by this control. An uncaptured hold still uses the existing cancellation/release workflow. Check Available to refund, then choose Refund payment. Keep Full remaining amount or choose Partial amount and enter the exact amount. Enter a reason of 3–300 characters, review the amount in the confirmation and submit once. Successful matched refunds already visible in Verifone history reduce the ceiling, including refunds made in Central; incomplete or unverified history blocks a new operation. The bounded history lookup covers transactions created within two years. A captured ABS sale still AUTHORISED/AUTHORIZED or SETTLEMENT REQUESTED is not settled: Admin shows Available to void and only Void entire payment, with no prior refund. Refund payment and Available to refund require an explicit settled state or verified partially-refunded history. Generic APPROVED/COMPLETED, contradictory states or missing evidence offer neither action. A state change before confirmation rejects the stale action; it never switches VOID to REFUND automatically. Request rejected by Verifone means no return of funds is confirmed, not necessarily an issuer decline. VOID is full only, never partial. Eligibility follows the provider state and merchant/acquirer rules, not midnight or a fixed 24-hour cutoff. Final acceptance is confirmed by Verifone. Read Payment operations for the amount, reason, date, actor account and provider transaction ID. Confirmed by Verifone requires an independent transaction read with matching parent, amount, currency, reference and merchant. A partial refund leaves the payment marked paid; a full confirmed return marks its payment refunded. Neither changes food status, items, stock or fulfillment. If the result is unknown or the browser loses the response, do not submit another refund or switch to VOID. Use Check with Verifone, which only verifies existing operations. A request with no recoverable provider ID stays blocked for support/Central verification, including after reload or an API restart. Never treat an HTTP success alone as refunded. Check the corresponding Invoice4U credit/cancellation document separately; this control does not confirm or create a fiscal credit document. FoodyPOS has a separate Transactions workflow for a server-verified original Checkout payment; these Admin instructions do not cover POS terminal refunds. After a full return verified against matched Verifone history, the summary keeps the original amount, shows the full amount returned and zero remaining, and offers no further refund or VOID. A cleared capture balance after that return is not an uncaptured hold to release. Missing or inconsistent evidence still requires verification without resubmission. Refund a POS-listed online payment to its original method In POS Transactions, choose a confirmed Verifone Checkout payment and request a return only when the server verifies its original payment ID, merchant, provider status and available amount. The selected transaction must match the order's payment; a shared order is not enough to authorize a different charge. A settled payment may be refunded to the same card, while an eligible captured unsettled payment may be voided in full. Enter a reason and confirm once. If the result is unknown, use the existing-operation check rather than submitting again. This does not refund a Victa terminal card payment or turn a card payment into a cash return. Keep the hosted payment form readable When Foody enables a restaurant-branded Verifone hosted checkout, the payment page uses light surfaces and dark text, even if the restaurant website is dark. The published logo is kept and the brand/button accent is adapted when needed for readable contrast. This concerns online hosted payments, not POS terminals or native Apple Pay/Google Pay sheets. If an older page is unreadable, contact the Foody team to resynchronize its payment theme. The update applies to newly issued Checkout links, not the page already open. Check the current payment status before requesting another link; never repeat a debit because of a display problem. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Payment configuration The payment provider is configured for each restaurant by the Foody team through the backoffice. Available payment methods depend on that configuration, the merchant contract and the order channel. Sumit and Verifone are integrated; availability must be confirmed for your installation. New PayPlus checkout is disabled. Check an online payment 1. Open the order in Orders . 2. Check its payment status and recorded method. 3. A return from a payment page is not by itself proof of payment. Foody verifies the payment with the provider before marking it paid. 4. For online orders requiring payment, confirmation makes the order available to the POS workflow. A failed or uncertain result Do not assume that a timeout means no money was taken. Check the order and provider transaction before retrying a charge. Contact Foody support if they disagree or the outcome is unclear. Never include full card details, CVV or credentials in a support message. Cash/manual recording, receipts, invoice issuance and refunds are separate operations. Their available controls depend on your setup and permissions. Do not record a card payment as successful solely because a customer shows a return page. Ask support for the procedure applicable to your provider before a refund or correction. Save a card during the first payment (CST) On the CST test setup validated with Verifone, sign in or create your Foody customer account, explicitly select Save card, then confirm the order. The hosted Verifone page collects the card, CVV and Israeli ID and charges the full order amount while creating the reusable token. There is no separate 1 ILS registration payment and no automatic monthly charge. Foody opens confirmation only after verifying the transaction. On later orders, choose the saved card and explicitly confirm the new amount; the configured No-CVV contract requires neither CVV nor Israeli ID. A delayed result requires checking status, never repeating the debit. Previously issued registration links keep their old recovery flow. Weighted holds remain outside this new registration flow. Production availability requires separate merchant approval. Check an itemized Invoice4U invoice When Invoice4U issuance and an invoice document type are enabled by the Foody team for the merchant, ordinary immediate Verifone order payments send the saved order lines: items and quantities, selected variants/options, combo base and included components, order discount and delivery fee. Frozen prices already include VAT; it is not added again. The line total must equal the payment amount or payment initiation is blocked. The same detail is sent for a later saved-card sale. Legacy orders without catalogue lines and catering/table/capture operations keep their existing document behavior. An approved payment is not proof that Invoice4U issued a fiscal document: check the document in Verifone Central/Invoice4U and customer delivery. Do not create another payment to obtain a missing invoice. Stock reservations after late payment Predefined item stocks now have a journal under Items & menus → Stock history and on each product. A rotating carte can prepare initial allowances per series and publish them without restoring already committed units. Previous remaining counts are not carried forward. Order changes and pre-production releases use the original frozen pool; a produced item remains consumed. Ingredient/preparation quantities and recipe costs remain separate. See Availability for initial imports, corrections and history filters. Access the new controls The entry sign-in invitation is now a published website order-journey preference. Order without an account remains available; this setting does not replace mandatory phone verification or payment/delivery validation. Google/Geoapify consumption and limits are separately available in Usage and quotas.

articles.title: Take payments on the POS
articles.description: Open the intended bill and verify its current amount before Pay. Available tenders depend on the restaurant and device configuration.
articles.body: Open the intended bill and verify its current amount before Pay. Available tenders depend on the restaurant and device configuration. The full-screen progress and automatic post-payment return described below require the matching POS version; an API update alone does not change the installed payment UI. To name a check from Continue/Send before collecting payment, follow custom check creation. Refund or void a Verifone online payment The Admin order payment section supports total or partial matched refunds and total VOID for an eligible single Verifone online payment, for owners/managers with payments.manage. Provider state, captured amount and verified history govern eligibility, not a fixed 24-hour rule. This does not cancel preparation or fulfillment and does not add a POS terminal refund button. Unknown results stay reserved and must be checked, never resubmitted. Invoice4U credit/cancellation documents require a separate check. See the online payment procedure. A captured ABS sale still AUTHORISED/AUTHORIZED or SETTLEMENT REQUESTED is not settled: Admin shows Available to void and only Void entire payment, with no prior refund. The published logo is kept and the brand/button accent is adapted when needed for readable contrast. This concerns online hosted payments, not POS terminals or native Apple Pay/Google Pay sheets. If an older page is unreadable, contact the Foody team to resynchronize its payment theme. The update applies to newly issued Checkout links, not the page already open. Check the current payment status before requesting another link; never repeat a debit because of a display problem. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Record cash On an enrolled POS with an active PIN shift, first open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance and enter the physical opening float. Then choose cash on the intended order or financial bill, enter the amount received and check the change before confirming. Only record money actually received. A pending cash collection must be retried with its existing identity, not recreated as another sale. Split bills keep their own receipt and paid status. Retry an unconfirmed cash-drawer read If Cash drawer balance or Cash movements cannot be read, do not infer that no drawer is open. Retry reads the state on the same device without a cash movement or Verifone deposit. New operations stay unavailable until the state is confirmed. Preserve pending operations with their identifiers and do not erase local data. Specific messages need compatible POS and API versions; this guide does not confirm installation. See cash-access diagnostics for refusals and safe recovery. Count and close the cash drawer On the same enrolled POS with an active PIN shift, open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance. Review the opening float, cash sales and refunds, paid in/out and expected cash. The optional description is copied to the closing note, without automatic saving. With payments.manage, open Paid in/out, enter a positive amount and mandatory reason, then choose Pay in cash or Pay out cash. A payout cannot exceed the expected balance. With orders.manage, choose Close cash session, count physical cash, enter that amount and confirm; any discrepancy is preserved. Dismissing the modal without confirming records nothing. Cash movements lists only the session loaded on this device, not past sessions. Resume any uncertain operation using its existing identity before another action. Cards are excluded: closing cash does not start a Verifone deposit, and a Verifone deposit does not close cash. Never use a cash adjustment to disguise a card refund. Collect a connected payment On an ordinary counter or table check on the updated handheld terminal, Pay opens a black customer review with the selected check’s lines, modifiers and confirmed amount. Review it before Confirm and pay. The ⋯ menu offers cash; the language selector changes only this review, without changing the device language. Dismissing the review collects nothing. Tablets retain the full-screen Card/Cash tender choice. Choose Pay by card. Foody keeps a full-screen progress view during preparation, terminal connection, reported login/session/parameter stages, the terminal instructions, payment recording and the counter order's kitchen send. Only stages actually reported are shown; not every payment needs every stage. Card reading and PIN entry remain on the secure Verifone terminal. The displayed kitchen send confirms order submission, not physical paper output: only categories selected in the assigned kitchen profile print. The screen closes on refusal or cancellation without marking the bill paid; review the displayed error before retrying. Wait for Foody’s verified final status; browser return alone is insufficient. If the result is pending/uncertain, refresh and review the provider transaction with an authorized operator before any retry. Never ask the help assistant to inspect card details. Before collection, Foody checks the bill data again. A change to lines, amount, paid state or restaurant/account context stops the flow: reopen Pay and confirm the updated review. The same check protects cash confirmation. An interrupted review does not establish a charge; if the provider has already returned an uncertain result, use the reconciliation procedure below. A new item or kitchen batch added to the check during review or cash entry also requires fresh confirmation; it must not be ignored when collecting. This Victa checkout uses ILS; changing language does not convert currency. Find a completed payment in Transactions Open Transactions in the iPad POS navigation, in More on compact terminals, or in the Admin sidebar, with payments.view or payments.manage. All three screens read the same restaurant-scoped confirmed payment history. In Admin choose a date range, source and method; search by item, reference or order number, then select a payment for its amount, method and linked orders. On the POS, selecting a linked order opens its saved read-only detail without leaving Transactions; if it cannot load, refresh and retry. The source follows the linked order: a provider-processed payment for a POS-created order appears under POS, not Online. Totals cover all matching payments, not just the visible page, and keep currencies separate. One order can have several tenders and one tender can cover several orders; Orders remains the place to follow fulfillment. Pending terminal attempts are not completed sales. History does not issue new receipts. Authorized owners and managers may see server-verified cash refunds or Verifone Checkout original-card returns for eligible payments; see the refund procedure before acting. If a result is missing, check restaurant, date and filters, then reconcile uncertain terminal payments before another charge. Understand payment origin Open a transaction on POS or Admin and read Payment origin separately from Source. Source identifies where the linked order was created; origin identifies cash, Verifone Checkout, another provider, or a recorded card payment. Victa (recorded payment) and Card (origin unverified) mean Foody recorded a result; they do not prove that a refund can be sent to the terminal. Older grouped payments can show Origin not attributed. For a return, confirm the original tender and use its authorized refund workflow; never substitute cash for a card payment. Search every item and retry the history Search Transactions by any item in a linked order, including items after the first four. Open a payment to review the available linked item names. On the POS, if loading more results fails, the payments already shown remain visible; choose Try again under the list to continue. This retries only the history request, not a card charge. Read refunds and payment voids in Transactions A successful Verifone Checkout refund or void initiated in Foody appears as its own return transaction, linked to the original payment. A confirmed cash return also appears separately, linked to its original cash tender. On the POS, an owner or manager with payments.manage can open an eligible payment in Transactions. For a journaled cash sale, choose Issue refund only when the server confirms an exact refundable portion and an open enrolled drawer. Select the order or check portion, enter an amount within the limit and a reason, then hand over cash only after Foody confirms. For one captured Verifone Checkout card payment linked to one exact order allocation, choose Refund to original card or Cancel card payment if offered. Enter a reason and, for a refund, an amount within the displayed limit. Foody sends the return to the original card, never to the cash drawer. An uncertain card result must be rechecked using the same saved request before another return; do not issue cash instead. Legacy unattributed, split/multi-order and Victa card payments do not offer this card action. Admin shows gross collections separately from returns recorded in Foody; neither figure is net revenue. Returns made directly in Verifone Central or on Victa are not included automatically. Read the transaction total correctly The Admin date range and displayed times use the restaurant’s timezone. The total sums all confirmed payment records matching the selected filters, even across several pages. Currencies remain separate. It is a gross payment total, not net sales: refunds, processing fees, cash-drawer movements and terminal end-of-day deposits are not subtracted here. Use the appropriate provider and accounting reports before reconciling a day. Close and deposit a Verifone terminal batch On a configured Victa Portable or an iPad connected to a Victa Mini, sign in with the payments.manage permission. Open More → Reports → Terminal deposits. Check that the terminal is connected and supports Close and deposit. At end of day, confirm Close and deposit once, then wait for the terminal's final confirmation and keep its reconciliation reference. This is separate from closing a Foody staff shift or a cash drawer. If the result is uncertain, do not repeat it or start another card payment: inspect the terminal batch or confirm its status with your payment provider. A manager may choose I verified the batch only after that check. Some Israeli Ashrait versions support the deposit but do not implement current totals, close-only or reconcile-only reports: those controls remain unavailable. Accepting the command alone does not prove completion, and a deposit can succeed without returning numerical totals. Never share terminal credentials or card details with support chat. Physical end-to-end compatibility must be validated for the provisioned terminal and software version. If the restaurant, sign-in or terminal changes, reopen confirmation in the correct context. Read totals or use advanced terminal actions In More → Reports → Terminal deposits, View current totals reads the active batch without closing or transmitting it. Advanced actions are shown only when supported by the terminal: Close batch only closes the reporting period without transmission; Transmit only requests acquirer reconciliation without explicitly closing it. Neither advanced action alone is the standard end-of-day flow. Use either only on your payment provider's instruction, confirm once and wait for the terminal's final result. If unsupported or uncertain, do not assume success; check the terminal or ask the provider before retrying. Verify payment for one QR order From Orders → Menu → Actions → Manage this order, offered actions affect the selected number only, never the combined value of the table’s QR orders. Collection is offered only for an eligible unpaid order in its workflow and with payments.manage; pending, partial or already-paid states do not permit charging the full total again. Verify number, state and amount before confirming. Changing restaurant or operator, or losing permission, invalidates the open action. A terminal approval arriving after that change remains to be reconciled: do not repeat the charge. View table is separate navigation that neither pays nor closes anything. Existing Verifone rules, journals and final terminal confirmation remain in place. Review tips and receipt Review any supported tip step before collection and confirm the total; availability depends on configuration. After confirmed payment for an ordinary check on the updated terminal, the receipt page offers Print when a printing action is available, or No receipt. Print requests an additional copy through the existing printing service; configured automatic receipt output may already have been requested. Email and SMS remain disabled when no sending service is supplied; they do not establish delivery. After the choice, You’re all set appears; New sale explicitly finishes the flow. For cash, the receipt shows known change, or No change for exact payment; missing or invalid values are omitted. Card receipts show no cash change. A fully paid table returns to the floor only after server-confirmed closure; an Open checks home configuration can retain its list. If restaurant, bill or permissions changed during receipt choice, Foody does not automatically close the old context. If closure fails after recorded payment, resume closure of that same check without collecting again. On a failed or uncertain print result, inspect history and jobs before another copy; never repeat payment. Per-check refunds are not established for every advanced split flow: use an authorized manager rather than assuming a refund button exists. Check an itemized Invoice4U invoice This concerns online orders, not a new POS terminal integration. When Invoice4U issuance and an invoice document type are enabled by the Foody team for the merchant, ordinary immediate Verifone order payments send the saved order lines: items and quantities, selected variants/options, combo base and included components, order discount and delivery fee. Frozen prices already include VAT; it is not added again. The line total must equal the payment amount or payment initiation is blocked. The same detail is sent for a later saved-card sale. Legacy orders without catalogue lines and catering/table/capture operations keep their existing document behavior. An approved payment is not proof that Invoice4U issued a fiscal document: check the document in Verifone Central/Invoice4U and customer delivery. Do not create another payment to obtain a missing invoice. Wait for counter card payment before kitchen preparation For a new counter pickup order paid by card, choose Pay, then Pay by card. Wait for terminal approval and for Foody to record the payment before preparation and the kitchen ticket start. During collection the payment remains pending and is excluded from the live order board. After a refusal or cancellation, keep the same checkout and retry there; do not send it to the kitchen to bypass payment. If approval succeeded but synchronization failed, reconcile the existing payment before starting another charge. Orders deliberately sent for table service before collection keep their existing send-then-pay flow. Confirm a paid counter takeaway sale After collecting a counter takeaway sale and confirming its kitchen send, the updated handheld terminal opens receipt choice; choose an available receipt action or No receipt, then New sale. Tablets retain the brief Payment recorded confirmation and automatic return after about two seconds. The tablet header shows the tender and sale amount; on the handheld, the receipt retains known cash change, or No change for exact payment. Unknown or invalid change stays unspecified. Use Transactions, available in More on the handheld, to consult the collection with the required payment-read permission. This confirmation never charges, reprints or pretends that a pending result succeeded. The paid order remains active while it is being prepared: payment does not mark it ready or handed over. Orders and Transactions refresh when reopened. If payment is recorded but the kitchen send is unconfirmed, keep the existing bill and retry only its send; never charge again. Kitchen tickets and customer receipts are separate. Automatic kitchen output requires an enabled printer profile with In-person order tickets, the item's categories selected and the printer associated with the current POS installation. This includes manually entered takeaway sales, not just table service. Configure profiles in FoodyAdmin or More → Settings → Hardware → Printers → Profiles on the POS. Reinstalling or using another POS installation can require discovering the printer and assigning the existing profile again. A successful payment or a queued print job does not prove paper was printed. Check the printer's history and queued/uncertain jobs before reconnecting or reprinting; pending documents can print after reconnection. If a confirmed paid takeaway bill remains before kitchen dispatch, Send to kitchen resumes only that send, even with a customized preparation workflow. It never requests a tender or another charge. If the original tender is absent, confirmation uses a neutral Payment heading, not an invented card payment. Before reassigning a printer, review its pending-document warning and routing. Find Pay on mobile On an ordinary check on the updated terminal, open Check then Pay at the bottom. It stays unavailable until the workflow permits collection. Review the customer summary, lines and amount before Confirm and pay; use ⋯ for cash. Card and PIN entry stay on Verifone’s secure screen. Only a confirmed, recorded result opens receipt choice and New sale. Neither a tab change nor an animation confirms payment. Never repeat collection with an unknown result. Other check commands, including permitted prepayment printing, remain in the check’s ⋯ menu. Read transactions and reports on mobile Transactions uses the full width for its list; tap a row to open details and use Back to return to the list. Filters, pagination and access permissions remain those of the journal. On compact screens, details and the cash-drawer report use terminal-sized insets. The visual change starts no collection, refund or deposit.

After a full return verified against matched Verifone history, the summary keeps the original amount, shows the full amount returned and zero remaining, and offers no further refund or VOID. A cleared capture balance after that return is not an uncaptured hold to release. Missing or inconsistent evidence still requires verification without resubmission. Keep the hosted payment form readable When Foody enables a restaurant-branded Verifone hosted checkout, the payment page uses light surfaces and dark text, even if the restaurant website is dark. The published logo is kept and the brand/button accent is adapted when needed for readable contrast. This concerns online hosted payments, not POS terminals or native Apple Pay/Google Pay sheets. If an older page is unreadable, contact the Foody team to resynchronize its payment theme. The update applies to newly issued Checkout links, not the page already open. Check the current payment status before requesting another link; never repeat a debit because of a display problem. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Arrange provider activation Payment-provider credentials and activation are managed by the Foody team in the protected backoffice. Contact an authorized Foody operator to change them; the merchant Payments page does not connect a card processor. Use sandbox development to verify the supported transaction path. Never send credentials or card data to chat. SUMIT/Verifone availability depends on the contract; a provider name alone does not prove activation. Understand saved payment methods For an eligible customer/provider, saving a method requires its explicit enrollment flow. Guest checkout remains possible without enrollment where offered. Removing Foody’s saved authorization does not remove unrelated provider subscriptions. A failed enrollment can be reported after a successful order payment without undoing that payment. Configure and use Cibus In Cibus check whether the integration is enabled. With settings permission, replace the complete restaurant ID, POS ID and company code through the protected form; masked hints are not replacement credentials. Review the saved masked status. On POS select Cibus only when configured and inspect its result and remaining balance before another tender. A failed network response does not prove there was no charge. Set payment policy, VAT and tips In Settings → Payments review online-payment-only policy, default VAT and tips enablement. Only permitted, changed fields are saved. An unknown policy remains unknown until explicitly chosen; editing VAT must not silently choose it. The weight authorization margin has its own editable field, explained below. Fixed suggested tips and rounding remain outside this form's edit contract. Verify saved values after success; retain edits on a failed save. Save a card during the first payment (CST) On the CST test setup validated with Verifone, sign in or create your Foody customer account, explicitly select Save card, then confirm the order. The hosted Verifone page collects the card, CVV and Israeli ID and charges the full order amount while creating the reusable token. There is no separate 1 ILS registration payment and no automatic monthly charge. Foody opens confirmation only after verifying the transaction. On later orders, choose the saved card and explicitly confirm the new amount; the configured No-CVV contract requires neither CVV nor Israeli ID. A delayed result requires checking status, never repeating the debit. Previously issued registration links keep their old recovery flow. Weighted holds remain outside this new registration flow. Production availability requires separate merchant approval. Check an itemized Invoice4U invoice When Invoice4U issuance and an invoice document type are enabled by the Foody team for the merchant, ordinary immediate Verifone order payments send the saved order lines: items and quantities, selected variants/options, combo base and included components, order discount and delivery fee. Frozen prices already include VAT; it is not added again. The line total must equal the payment amount or payment initiation is blocked. The same detail is sent for a later saved-card sale. Legacy orders without catalogue lines and catering/table/capture operations keep their existing document behavior. An approved payment is not proof that Invoice4U issued a fiscal document: check the document in Verifone Central/Invoice4U and customer delivery. Do not create another payment to obtain a missing invoice.

articles.title: Set up an Epson TM-U220IIB with Foody
articles.description: From unboxing to the first kitchen ticket: network setup, Epson Server Direct Print, FoodyAdmin registration, stations, routing, and testing.
articles.body: Open the corresponding Foody workspace described below. What you need - The printer and its Epson power supply. - A compatible ribbon cassette and 76 mm paper roll. - An Ethernet cable connected to the restaurant router or switch. - A computer or iPad on the same network during setup. - A FoodyAdmin owner or manager account with printer-management permission. - A router DHCP reservation, recommended so WebConfig remains easy to reach. Do not use a guest network. Guest Wi-Fi commonly isolates devices. Foody does not require an incoming port at the restaurant: the printer makes an outbound HTTPS connection to Foody. 1. Unbox and inspect the printer 1. Remove the printer, power supply, power cord, and ribbon cassette from the box. 2. Remove all transport foam, tape, and protective material. 3. Check the label underneath or behind the printer. Record the exact model, serial number, and MAC address. 4. Place the printer away from splashes, steam, and heat, leaving room to open both covers. 5. Keep the printer switched off while connecting cables. The MAC address identifies the network interface and can be used for a DHCP reservation. 2. Load the ribbon and paper 2. Load the ribbon and paper Ribbon cassette 1. With the printer off, open the ribbon cover. 2. Take up slack by gently turning the cassette knob in the indicated direction. 3. Fit the cassette flat and press until it is seated. 4. Close the cover without forcing it. The print head may be very hot after use. Do not touch it or force the ribbon carriage by hand. Paper roll 1. Open the paper cover with its release lever. 2. Insert the roll in the direction shown inside the cover. Paper should unwind without tension. 3. Pull a few centimetres of paper straight out. 4. Close the cover fully and tear off the excess at the tear bar. 3. Connect the printer to the network 1. Connect Ethernet between the printer and the router or switch. 2. Connect the Epson power supply to the printer, then to a reliable outlet. 3. Power on and wait for the error light to go out. 4. Print a network status sheet with the status button on the Ethernet interface. Its position depends on the installed interface; do not use the reset button. 5. Find the IPv4 address , for example 192.168.1.48 . If the address is 0.0.0.0 or missing, check the cable and switch port. An address beginning with 169.254 means the router did not provide an address. 4. Open Epson TMNet WebConfig 1. From the computer or iPad on the same network, open https://IP-ADDRESS . If HTTPS is not yet enabled on the device, use http://IP-ADDRESS only for this local setup. 2. If the browser warns about a local certificate, continue only after confirming that the IP matches the printed status sheet. 3. Sign in with the administrator credentials printed on the product label or supplied in the printer documentation. Change the default password. 4. Reserve the address in the router, or ask the network administrator to configure a suitable static address. The IP address is only for on-site administration. It is not entered in Foody because Server Direct Print uses an outbound connection from the printer to the cloud. 5. Register the printer in FoodyAdmin Open FoodyAdmin → Settings → Printers , then select Register printer . Field Recommended value --- --- Name Physical location: Kitchen , Pizza pass , Bar 1 , or Bar 2 Vendor Epson Server Direct Print Model Exact reference, for example TM-U220IIB-i Epson gateway Direct if this printer polls Foody; otherwise select the registered Epson gateway WebConfig ID A unique ID such as restaurant-kitchen-01 Printer device ID local printer in direct mode; the exact WebConfig device ID in gateway mode Width TM-U220 · 76 mm · 384 dots Interval 2 s Station Select an existing station or create one named after its physical location Select Register . Foody then displays these values once: - Server Direct Print URL; - status notification URL; - WebConfig ID; - password; - Digest realm. Keep this screen open for the next step. The password is not shown again after closing. Do not send it through an unsecured message or photograph. 6. Configure Server Direct Print in WebConfig In TMNet WebConfig, open Server Direct Print and enable it. Copy the values generated by Foody exactly: 1. Server Direct Print URL : the print URL shown by Foody. 2. ID / User ID : the WebConfig ID selected in FoodyAdmin. 3. Password : the one-time password. 4. Device ID : local printer for the built-in printer, or the exact device ID registered behind a gateway. 5. Interval : 2 seconds. Enable Status Notification and enter its Foody URL with the same credentials. Save and apply the configuration, then allow the printer to restart if requested. Do not add spaces before or after the ID, password, or URLs. Foody URLs must remain https:// . 7. Wait for Online and print a test 1. Return to Settings → Printers . 2. Wait up to 15 seconds. Status should move from Unknown to Online , and Last seen should update. 3. Select Test or Print test ticket . 4. Wait for the complete ticket. Foody marks it printed only after the Epson confirms the result. 5. Check the station name, French and Hebrew characters, paper feed, and legibility. If status remains Unknown , the printer is not reaching Foody. If it is Online but the test fails, open Jobs to see the latest device error. 8. Create production stations A station is a logical destination. Menu components route to the station, and the station owns its printer. A failed printer can therefore be replaced without changing the menu. For a four-printer kitchen, a practical layout is: Station Primary printer Typical content --- --- --- Kitchen Kitchen Epson Hot dishes, starters, fried items Pizza pass Pizza Epson Pizzas and pizza extras Bar 1 First bar Epson Drinks and cocktails Bar 2 Second bar Epson A second drinks copy when both bars produce Use Full order copy for an expediter who needs the whole order. A fallback printer does not create a second copy; it is used only when the primary printer is unavailable. To print on both bar printers, create two stations and route drinks to both columns. 9. Route categories and exceptions Open Routing : 1. Check every station that should receive each category. 2. For example, route Pizzas to Pizza pass and Drinks to Bar 1 and Bar 2 . 3. Save the matrix. 4. Add an item override only when an item must leave its category route. 5. Add a modifier override for an independently produced component, such as a sauce sent to the kitchen while the main item goes to the grill. Before enabling server printing, the setup panel should show every printer tested, every station assigned, and every category routed. 10. Send a real Foody ticket 1. Enable Print kitchen tickets from the server . 2. In FoodyPOS, create a test order containing an item from each routed category and a modifier with a special route. 3. Confirm or send the order to the kitchen according to the restaurant workflow. 4. Confirm that each station receives only its lines and that a full-order station receives the complete order. 5. In FoodyAdmin, open Jobs . Each ticket should move from Queued to Awaiting confirmation , then Printed . Do not start live service until this end-to-end test passes. Keep the previous printing method available during the first live order as a temporary precaution. Quick troubleshooting Symptom What to check --- --- No network light Ethernet cable, switch port, and power Address 169.254.x.x The router's DHCP server did not answer WebConfig cannot be reached Same network, correct IP, and guest isolation disabled Server Direct Print is missing Non-intelligent model or incompatible firmware/interface Unknown in Foody Service disabled, wrong URL/ID/password, or blocked DNS/Internet Online but no order ticket Station not assigned, category not routed, or server printing disabled Failed job Open Jobs , fix the paper/cover/ribbon error, then run another test Wrong station Review the category matrix and item/modifier overrides Manufacturer documentation - Epson TM-U220IIB Series - Epson Server Direct Print manual - Lightspeed TM-U220B / TM-U220IIB setup guide WebConfig menu names can vary slightly by firmware and network interface. Do not factory-reset a printer during service. Photograph the product label, network status sheet, and relevant screen before contacting Foody. Distinguish WhatsApp PDFs from print jobs A receipt PDF attached to a WhatsApp automation is a digital order summary. It uses saved items and totals but creates no print job, requires no online printer and does not appear in printer history. Configure it in Communications → WhatsApp or Order workflow. Existing paper receipts, profiles, diagnostics and printing rules remain configured in the printing screens. Check printed variant positions For an item with variant positions, check that the ticket lists each choice in order, for example Character 1: A then Character 2: 7. These choices describe the product and carry no addition/removal sign or surcharge. If a detail is missing, check the API and ordering client versions, then the item configuration under Variants and sizes. Connection, routing and print recovery procedures remain the same.

articles.title: Printer profiles and routing
articles.description: Open POS → More → Settings → Hardware → Printers/Profiles, or Admin → Settings → Printers.
articles.body: Open POS → More → Settings → Hardware → Printers/Profiles, or Admin → Settings → Printers. The pending-document confirmation described below requires the matching POS version; updating the API alone does not add it to an older installation. Find an Epson printer on the local network 1. Connect the iPad or Victa and the supported Epson printer to the same local network. Switch on the printer and check its paper and cover. Your account must have access to printer settings. 2. Open POS → More → Settings → Hardware → Printers and select Scan network . Opening the page can also start a scan. Wait until the scan finishes. 3. On iPad, allow Local Network access when iOS asks. If the first scan is empty after granting permission, run Scan network again. If access was denied, enable it for FoodyPOS in iPad Settings, then retry. 4. Check the discovered model and IP address. Users with printer-management permission can register discovered printers and assign their profiles; read-only printer access does not register devices. 5. If Scan network is disabled with a notice, the installed build does not enable automatic discovery. Existing configured printers still work. Use Connect a printer → Select a printer → Advanced printer configuration → Epson printer to enter its IP address, or install the supported update when distributed. If no printer is found, check that the Wi-Fi allows local device communication and that the devices are not on isolated guest networks. Manual IP entry remains available when broadcast discovery is blocked. Discovery does not prove printing: deliberately run one test and check the paper before requesting another copy.
