Create or edit a shared profile Managers can create/edit, disable/reactivate or delete shared profiles. New profiles begin with supported job types off: enable receipt, onsite or online tickets deliberately. A shared edit affects assigned devices; deletion removes routing metadata, not physical printers or job history. Set ticket options Configure categories, one item per ticket, kitchen names, combining identical items, footer, margins, new-category behavior, copies, recipient details, font size and sorting where offered. Common settings are shared within one profile. Save explicitly; failed saves retain your draft. Assign the right printer In Admin assign installation/printer mappings to the intended active profiles. Disabling a profile suspends routing while preserving the assignment. Editing a profile does not replace device mappings. Verify the actual transport and printer identity before a deliberate development test ticket. On the POS, open More → Settings → Hardware → Printers, select the printer, then Assign profiles. Assign the existing shared profile for this POS installation; another iPad or Portable's assignment does not configure this one. If pending documents are reported when adding a profile or using Quick setup, Foody asks before continuing. View history leaves the assignment unchanged and opens read-only history; Cancel changes nothing. Confirm only after checking the queue and paper: waiting jobs may print when routing resumes. The action never itself cancels jobs, requests reprints or collects payment. A restaurant change or loss of printer-management permission before confirmation abandons the assignment. Edit a profile on a handheld terminal Open More → Hardware → Printers → Profiles, select the profile and choose Edit. The editor fills the mobile screen. Choose Receipts, In-person tickets or Online tickets to open its options. The switch enables that document type in the draft; select categories under Categories to print. Remove top margin preserves the bottom setting; the bottom margin remains separately editable. Shared profile preferences apply across its ticket types. Return to the editor and Save; leaving a changed draft asks for confirmation, and a failed save retains it. Automatically including new categories does not mean automatically printing new orders. Installation assignments remain separate from the shared profile.

articles.title: Printer status and history
articles.description: Open the configured printer’s detail, then Pending document printing → View history.
articles.body: Open the configured printer’s detail, then Pending document printing → View history. Check connectivity Check explicit online/offline/unknown status, power, paper and network. Unknown is not Ready. Star CloudPRNT, compatible Epson/gateway and native Victa paths depend on the actual configured model/transport; USB, Bluetooth or AirPrint are not universally supported. Read the last 24 hours View the paginated last-24-hour history and inspect job kind/state/times. It is read-only and excludes ticket/customer content. Refresh does not claim or reprint jobs. For uncertain printing, reconcile the queued job before requesting another ticket to avoid duplicates. Distinguish WhatsApp PDFs from print jobs A receipt PDF attached to a WhatsApp automation is a digital order summary. It uses saved items and totals but creates no print job, requires no online printer and does not appear in printer history. Configure it in Communications → WhatsApp or Order workflow. Existing paper receipts, profiles, diagnostics and printing rules remain configured in the printing screens. Check printed variant positions For an item with variant positions, check that the ticket lists each choice in order, for example Character 1: A then Character 2: 7. These choices describe the product and carry no addition/removal sign or surcharge. If a detail is missing, check the API and ordering client versions, then the item configuration under Variants and sizes. Connection, routing and print recovery procedures remain the same. Read history on mobile Hardware → Printers → select the printer → View history opens a mobile list with a back control at the top. Refresh and Load more remain read-only. Print test is a separate action on the printer details page; opening history starts no test, retry or reprint.

articles.title: External service usage and quotas
articles.description: Admin → Settings → Usage and quotas
articles.body: Admin → Settings → Usage and quotas Read your restaurant usage With permission to view or edit settings, open Usage and quotas. Each Google service has an independent counter and limit: address suggestions, details, geocoding, routes, single-courier or fleet optimization, and tiles. Geoapify shares one estimated-credit allowance across its services, including fallback calls. Deliveries submitted for optimization are units; recalculations count again. One map can request multiple tiles. Request counts are also shown when the unit differs. Refresh reloads usage; after a failure use Retry. This page is read-only and never shows other restaurants’ usage. Understand limits and renewal Initial monthly allowances are 2,000 suggestions, 500 details, 500 Google geocodes, 500 Google routes, 500 single-courier optimized deliveries, 100 fleet deliveries, 10,000 Google tiles and 3,000 Geoapify credits. Foody can adjust each restaurant’s limits; contact the team for a change. A warning appears from 80%. At the limit new calls for that service are blocked; an available fallback uses its own allowance. Address entry never bypasses delivery validation. Shared provider safeguards remain applicable even when this restaurant has allowance left. Periods are UTC months with a displayed renewal date. Tracking begins at the stated activation date, without reconstructing earlier calls. Failed and uncertain attempts remain counted. Geoapify estimates retain quarter credits; distance surcharges can exceed the initial estimate and are recorded on response. An allowance is not a guaranteed provider invoice or a purchase of paid overage.

articles.title: Devices and kitchen displays
articles.description: Open Settings → Devices or Kitchen displays. Configure routing and permissions before using a device in service.
articles.body: Open Settings → Devices or Kitchen displays. Configure routing and permissions before using a device in service. Keep an enrolled Victa and its integrated printer linked A Victa running Foody can report itself through the POS print agent as well as through its payment-terminal capability. With the corrected API, an older generic Android hardware report does not downgrade a terminal capability already registered for that active device. Its integrated printer keeps the same owned parent, identity, profiles and job history. This is not automatic discovery or payment certification, and it does not turn an ordinary tablet into a payment terminal. If the device or integrated printer becomes unavailable after an update, retain the error and have the device inventory and API version checked. Do not forget, recreate or move devices between restaurants as a workaround, and do not resend queued documents or payments merely to test connectivity. Forgotten devices remain forgotten; printer routing and uncertain-job recovery still require their own checks. Configure devices Find the correct device, review its identity, active state and selected POS profile. Do not reuse an activation code across restaurants. A staff role and a device profile have different responsibilities; check both if a screen or action is unavailable. After forgetting or replacing a device, check the current device's mode assignment explicitly. Cleanup of a forgotten assignment does not transfer the profile to a replacement; see saving settings after a forgotten device for compatible-version requirements and recovery. Set kitchen stations Create or edit the station and assign its allowed item categories and device access. Review priority and completion behavior. An item can route to its configured production station while keeping its customer-facing menu group unchanged. Work with kitchen tickets Open the assigned KDS, inspect released tickets and advance or complete them using permitted controls. Held food is not a released ticket. Recall/priority actions must target the displayed ticket; do not re-send an order merely because its station is offline.

articles.title: Ordering and fulfillment rules
articles.description: Open Settings → Orders and Fulfillment. These rules affect customer eligibility, beyond the visual Website editor.
articles.body: Open Settings → Orders and Fulfillment. These rules affect customer eligibility, beyond the visual Website editor. Separate POS contacts from delivery eligibility POS methods under Settings → Fulfillment → Point of sale may ask for optional name/phone details for the whole check. They collect no address, create no account and do not relax online delivery requirements. Per-item labels describe preparation exceptions. All saved orders remain available on POS and Admin, subject to access and filters; there is no per-method tracking switch. See method settings. Mode selection and any customer prompt precede items in a new onsite sale. The table/check is chosen only at Send/Continue; cancellation preserves the source. See whole-check fulfillment. Private guest context is staff-only, never a public checkout answer or notification variable. Separate cash eligibility from cash collection Order-channel or fulfillment settings may allow a customer to choose cash or pay later, but that choice does not prove payment and does not add money to the POS cash drawer. A staff member records a cash sale only after collecting the money on an enrolled POS with an open drawer session. Review the order's payment status separately from fulfillment; the Verifone card batch is not part of this drawer. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Choose ordering channels Review enabled pickup, delivery and table modes and their minimums, fees and preparation settings. Change one rule at a time and inspect its customer-facing explanation. Public ordering can be paused independently of restaurant opening hours. Set scheduling limits Review immediate versus scheduled ordering, lead time, booking horizon and time-slot settings. Batch preorder cutoffs and delivery-tour dates have separate configuration. Verify that an offered slot satisfies all applicable rules. Use temporary test access carefully Temporary test access requires a specific public IP and expiry within seven days. Activation pauses public ordering. Tests create real orders and notifications; use development for test data. Expiry or revocation leaves ordering paused: resume explicitly when ready. Never publish an allowed IP list in a guide or message. Choose a stage attachment In Admin, open Settings → Restaurant → Order workflow and the required pickup or delivery stage. With Notify customer enabled, choose the message type, an approved Meta photo/PDF model and its attachment: a fixed file, or that order’s receipt for a PDF. Choose the sending time and save the workflow. Manual stage entry or its configured event uses this binding. Selecting a file changes neither progression, payment rules nor delivery eligibility. Correct an incompatible or missing model/file before relying on delivery. The model library and creation controls are in Settings → Communications → WhatsApp. Follow an assigned delivery’s departure When the assigned courier starts their route in Admin, unfinished accepted, preparing and ready delivery orders change together to Out for delivery. Staff screens receive the updated statuses through their usual order refresh. This confirms actual departure; assigning a courier or choosing a fulfillment mode alone does not start a route. Held kitchen courses and unsettled weight orders must be resolved first. If starting fails, the previous statuses remain. The route action does not reopen finished or cancelled orders. Make a one-order combo exception For a one-order combo exception, an authorized Admin user opens the combo step and selects Choose another item. The replacement is included without a surcharge and is saved on that order only. Fulfillment, scheduling and delivery rules remain unchanged. Review the selected dish and portion in the order details. Guest and POS combo pickers retain the configured composition; arrange an exception through the internal Admin order editor. See the combo guide for quantities, eligibility and recovery. Wait for counter card payment before kitchen preparation For a new counter pickup order paid by card, choose Pay, then Pay by card. Wait for terminal approval and for Foody to record the payment before preparation and the kitchen ticket start. During collection the payment remains pending and is excluded from the live order board. After a refusal or cancellation, keep the same checkout and retry there; do not send it to the kitchen to bypass payment. If approval succeeded but synchronization failed, reconcile the existing payment before starting another charge. Orders deliberately sent for table service before collection keep their existing send-then-pay flow. Move a reservation between series Predefined item stocks now have a journal under Items & menus → Stock history and on each product. A rotating carte can prepare initial allowances per series and publish them without restoring already committed units. Previous remaining counts are not carried forward. Order changes and pre-production releases use the original frozen pool; a produced item remains consumed. Ingredient/preparation quantities and recipe costs remain separate. See Availability for initial imports, corrections and history filters. Access the new controls The entry sign-in invitation is now a published website order-journey preference. Order without an account remains available; this setting does not replace mandatory phone verification or payment/delivery validation. Google/Geoapify consumption and limits are separately available in Usage and quotas. Staff contact details and courier destination Staff contact details are managed in Admin → Staff → employee → Edit contact details. The restaurant-scoped name and phone are used for courier assignment and upcoming delivery reminders; the sign-in email remains read-only. Couriers can save a default final destination or link it to their home address. New routes propose that destination and allow an explicit override or removal. It is the courier’s end-of-route destination, separate from the customer’s delivery address. Existing populated routes and completed delivery snapshots keep their saved data. See staff profiles for saving, permissions and recovery. POS code at staff activation Staff activation checks the permissions assigned in this restaurant, including custom roles: orders.manage or payments.manage requires a private POS code. Read-only couriers and kitchen-only roles do not need one. Existing unused invitation links apply the same current rule. Changing a role label, courier address or route destination does not grant POS permissions. See activation and recovery. Recover a delivery after a test departure Starting courier mode marks assigned orders Out for delivery. If this was a test departure, a user with order-management permission can open Orders → Deliveries, select the date and choose Undo departure while no arrival, delivery or skipped stop has been recorded. Out for delivery orders return to In preparation; the route returns to draft and can be unassigned and reallocated. This is a delivery correction, not a new order, refund or reprint. Payments and previously sent messages are preserved. See the dispatch procedure. Check conditional item choices An item configured with repeated positions requires one separate choice per position according to the selected format. For example, a two-character Number Cake accepts 11, AB or A7. The format price replaces the base price; modifiers add only their configured surcharges. Reducing the position count removes newly hidden choices. Positions remain distinct in the cart, orders and kitchen ticket; review them before confirming. These customizations do not change delivery, availability, recipe, discount or cancellation rules. Configuration requires compatible versions and menu editing permission. See Variants and sizes for setup and recovery after a rejected selection. Synchronize the POS mode policy Fulfillment methods belong to the restaurant; prompt timing and enabled modules follow the effective policy of the device’s assigned mode. The updated POS refreshes it automatically and waits for safe completion of an active payment, send or item edit before applying it. Refresh never repeats an operation. In Admin, a conflict retains the draft but requires reloading saved settings before a new edit. When the method prompt is disabled and Onsite is the default, a new sale stays onsite; Send asks for its table or permitted named check rather than converting it to Takeaway. Delivery, availability and payment settings retain their own validation. See settings and recovery. Check POS customer-screen compatibility Show customer information screen still controls whether details are offered immediately after a fulfillment method is selected. Its internal guest identifier and note also require an API supporting private guest details. A compatibility rejection confirms neither a kitchen send nor a payment: retain the current sale and have the API updated before resuming. Enabling the screen does not change available methods, their order, table selection at Send, delivery rules or printer profiles. Open the current weekly batch automatically For a restaurant configured for weekly batches, open Home or Orders using the Série date basis. The current batch is selected by default even without orders; its totals then stay at zero. It advances after the previous batch’s final fulfillment day in the restaurant timezone, without waiting for the first order or for ordering to open. An open page follows this change on the next automatic refresh (about one minute) or when you return to the tab. You can select an older service in the calendar; that selection stays in place while the page is open. An order for a later week does not replace the current batch as the default. A payment-attention link keeps its explicit period. If the date looks incorrect, check the configured fulfillment days and restaurant timezone, then reload. Rollover does not create an order or publish a menu. Control weekly ordering manually In Admin → Settings → Ordering & delivery → Orders & availability → Weekly batch, use settings.edit to choose Manual opening or According to a calendar, then Save changes. Manual opening keeps the current pause state; it never opens ordering merely by selecting the mode. Use Pause online orders → No to open, or Yes to pause. There is no automatic opening, cutoff or scheduled reopening in manual mode. Delivery/collection days and windows, preparation rules, stock and existing orders remain unchanged. New orders target the current delivery series even after the previous calendar cutoff, until its final service day ends in the restaurant timezone. Check the offered delivery date before confirming. Returning to calendar mode restores the retained hours. If saving fails, keep the draft and reload the confirmed status before retrying. Disable active Temporary test access before reopening publicly; expiry or disabling it alone leaves orders paused. Deploy the compatible API before enabling this choice; an older API leaves it unavailable.

articles.title: Configure the customer ordering assistant
articles.description: Open Settings → AI assistant. This is the restaurant’s customer ordering assistant, separate from the Foody help assistant.
articles.body: Open Settings → AI assistant. This is the restaurant’s customer ordering assistant, separate from the Foody help assistant. Enable and choose a trigger Review enablement, trigger and delay. Choose whether upselling and automatic cart proposals are allowed, then save and verify the saved state. These options do not bypass catalog availability, required choices, ordering rules or payment verification. Maintain guidance and FAQ Write factual guidance, aliases, pairings and FAQ using current restaurant information. Avoid secrets and personal customer data. Test ambiguous requests in each supported language. Use reset/discard to abandon unsaved edits; a failed save does not confirm the new configuration.

articles.title: Notifications and team preferences
articles.description: Open Settings → Notifications or Team, and distinguish personal preferences from restaurant-wide rules.
articles.body: Open Settings → Notifications or Team, and distinguish personal preferences from restaurant-wide rules. Choose notification preferences Select the events and channels offered for the current user/device. Grant browser or OS permission only when prompted for the intended device. Verify permission, subscription and recipient selection if alerts stop; device sound settings may also suppress them. Review team settings Review team defaults in Settings, then manage actual employees, roles and table assignments in Staff. Saving a notification preference does not grant a business permission. Use the staff member’s own account instead of sharing owner credentials.

articles.title: POS behavior, courses and adjustments
articles.description: Open Settings → POS, then the appropriate mode/profile. Legacy Full service settings redirect to the default profile.
articles.body: Open Settings → POS, then the appropriate mode/profile. Legacy Full service settings redirect to the default profile. Custom fulfillment editing and optional customer prompts below require compatible Admin, POS and API versions. Updating the API alone does not update Admin or the installed POS; an absent control is not proof of incorrect configuration. Set menu behavior Open Menu behavior and choose the options offered for item selection, modifiers and navigation. Assign the intended profile to the POS device. Test with an item that has a required choice so staff cannot accidentally skip it. A checkout-mode profile does not assign a kitchen printer. Configure the shared printing profile separately for this POS installation; see printer assignments and pending documents. Keep Admin and the assigned POS mode synchronized With compatible API and POS versions, compare the restaurant and assigned mode shown in POS → More → Settings → Checkout with that mode in Admin. Course activation, Send and stay and open-check options belong to the shared assigned mode, not an independent local iPad switch. Devices without an assigned mode use the restaurant defaults. Save changes once with the required settings permission. A foreground POS checks for updates about every 30 seconds and on resume, navigation and completion of a sale action. Updates are deferred during an in-flight payment, send or item edit and read again at the next safe boundary; they never restart that action. You can use Refresh in Checkout to request a fresh read. A failed read retains the last confirmed configuration and does not prove that Admin’s change was applied. When another editor changed the same setting or the device assignment, the API rejects the conflicting save instead of overwriting it. Refresh, verify the current mode and values, then reapply only the intended change. Do not reactivate all modules locally or repeat payments to force synchronization. Kitchen printer assignments remain separate. Retry a failed settings refresh safely If the POS shows the settings refresh warning, check the connection and use Retry in the banner, or Refresh in Checkout. The last confirmed settings remain in use; the warning does not mean that courses or open checks were intentionally disabled. Retry is unavailable while a sale action is in progress. Let the current action finish, then verify the assigned mode and recheck its values before continuing. Reading settings does not resend food, collect payment or change terminal deposits. If saving a setting was rejected because another editor changed it, refresh before reapplying only your intended edit; repeating the old complete snapshot can never be a recovery procedure. Configure service courses Open Services and maintain the restaurant’s course names and order. Enable course management and any permitted hold/fire or Send and stay options in the POS device’s assigned mode. In Straight fire, select the intended library categories, apply and save. This mapping uses each item’s restaurant-wide library category, not its display/menu group or a matching group name. An item in an immediate-send category enters Straight fire when added to an onsite sale, even while a named course is selected. Ordinary new items use the selected course. Check a freshly added line after a catalogue change; existing saved lines are not moved retroactively. Straight fire means the next explicit Send dispatches those pending lines immediately: simply adding the article does not send or print it. Named course Hold/Fire choices remain provisional until Send/Continue succeeds. Continue is available only when the assigned mode permits it and stays on the check; it does not automatically fire the next course. Courses organize kitchen release; they are distinct from financial splits, QR payment ownership and customer-facing menu groups. Check shared-mode synchronization if Admin and POS show different activation states. Review allowed adjustments Open Adjustments and review the available reasons and behavior for reductions, offerings and cancellation. Staff still need the corresponding permissions. Library POS discounts and online promotion codes are maintained in their own modules. Save settings after a device was forgotten or replaced An old POS-mode assignment to a device already forgotten in this restaurant should not block saving another setting, such as when to ask for a fulfillment method. This recovery requires an API version that includes forgotten-device cleanup; it is not guaranteed on older installations. Saving removes only the old assignment to that forgotten device. It does not reactivate the device or assign its replacement automatically. After registering a replacement, open the intended POS mode in Admin, choose Assigned devices , select the current device, then Apply and Save . Check the resulting assignment; printer profiles remain separate. If saving still fails, keep the draft, retain the error message and check the installed API version before retrying. Do not delete other modes or repeatedly reactivate devices to bypass the error. A new assignment to a missing, forgotten or foreign device remains invalid. Keep terminal deposits separate from POS behavior Terminal batch actions do not change the POS service profile, staff shift or cash drawer. A manager with payments.manage opens More → Reports → Terminal deposits on a configured Victa Portable or iPad/Victa Mini. Follow the dedicated POS payment guide for end-of-day confirmation and uncertain-result recovery; do not use menu behavior or adjustment settings to settle a batch. If the restaurant, sign-in or terminal changes, reopen confirmation in the correct context. Configure POS fulfillment methods With settings-edit permission, open Settings → Fulfillment → Point of sale. The catalogue shows cards for all methods, including hidden methods. Open a card to edit its display text, order type and optional customer prompt, then Save explicitly. A failed or unconfirmed save keeps the editor and values. Manage by location sets restaurant-wide availability, order/default and prompt timing, not a separate catalogue per device. Inside that nested editor, Save on a method stages it only: Save again in Manage by location persists the whole configuration. Closing a changed editor asks before discarding. Keep at least one method enabled and at most ten; reorder with arrows or the drag handle. The first enabled method becomes the default. Delete requires confirmation and cannot remove the last active method. Foody always tracks saved orders, with no per-method tracking-disable switch. Existing orders keep their recorded method. An incompatible API disables unsupported editing. Choose when staff select a method In the same editor, enable the staff selection prompt and choose At the start of each new order or After tapping Pay or Send , then Save explicitly. Switching the prompt off and back on while editing retains the selected timing. With start prompting, entering Menu asks for a method on an unsent sale, including a retained draft when returning from another page. Closing this entry selector by its cross or background accepts the configured enabled default without opening optional customer collection or a table. Adding items, removing the last item, and Pay/Send in that same visit do not reopen the method selector. A new-sale reset or leaving and returning to Menu asks again. A saved check is not a new sale and retains its recorded method. Tapping a method explicitly continues immediately and opens its optional customer form when enabled; the onsite destination remains deferred until Send/Continue. Closing a selector opened manually from Actions or at checkout cancels that action without changing the sale. Checkout-only prompting does not open on Menu entry. With prompting disabled, new unassigned sales take the default while a restored explicitly selected method is retained; if disabled since then, choose an available method explicitly through Actions. Customer-information options remain per method, but all saved orders are tracked through Orders → All on POS and Admin subject to restaurant scope, access and filters. Payment and preparation remain independent. See whole-check fulfillment. Enable the existing open-check workflow for onsite sales There is no separate tableless-dine-in switch. Keep a dine-in method available in the restaurant fulfillment catalogue. In the POS mode assigned to this device, open Open checks , enable Use on this mode and save if needed. Predefined ticket names remain optional. Compatible API/POS versions then offer New check without a table. If unavailable, check the capability message and effective device mode; do not enable unrelated seat or delivery settings. This uses no artificial table and does not change online/QR order rules. Admin Orders can display the resulting dine-in orders without a table; Admin's manual new-order form remains pickup/delivery only. Ask for customer details for a method Requires matching API and POS versions. Enable Show customer information screen in the method editor and Save (also save Manage by location if editing there). Immediately after choosing this whole-check mode, the optional details form appears before adding items, including for the default with selection prompts off. Enter first/last name or use Add new or existing customer to search the restaurant directory or Enter contact for this order only. Search requires customers.view; order contact requires orders.manage. Done confirms mode and contact together. Skip retains the previous contact without applying typed changes. Back reopens mode selection; closing the flow leaves the sale unchanged. Full name: at most 80 characters. Nonblank phone: at most 32 characters, with 7–15 digits and ordinary separators. A matching guest-details API capability enables a private identifier (255 characters) and staff note (500); otherwise those fields are disabled with an explanation. Private context stays on staff order data, not public views, receipts or notification text. No customer account, marketing consent, contacts import or cash authorization is created. Configured notifications may use the saved phone. Subsequent batches inherit coherent check details; mixed-customer or allocated bills cannot adopt a replacement contact. For a table constrained to one fulfillment method, selection may be implicit without showing the picker, while this form, compatibility checks and joint confirmation of method and contact remain in place. Closing or a changed context does not save a partial choice. Choose an existing contact or enter order-only details In the optional fulfillment details form, open Add new or existing customer. The Customers search requires customers.view and searches the active restaurant only after two characters. Selecting a result returns its existing name and phone without updating a profile. Enter contact is available with orders.manage even without directory access: enter separate first/last names and an optional phone, then Done. The combined trimmed name is limited to 80 Unicode code points; a nonblank phone requires 7–15 digits and at most 32 characters. Back retains these edits locally when returning to search; closing the picker applies nothing. A restaurant, permission or order-context change blocks selection, including a late search response. The details form still requires its own Done to apply the mode and contact together. This is not the creation of a persistent CRM profile: email, address, marketing consent, contacts import, groups and tax fields are not collected here. Configure checkout on a compact screen On mobile, settings use one page stack. Back first leaves the current subpage, then its section. Headers, fields and switches use the same terminal controls. Checkout preferences retain their existing permissions and persistence. Printer options remain a draft until Save in the profile editor. Under Appearance, mobile retains neutral surfaces and blue actions; custom colors remain available on tablets. Light/dark theme and language remain configurable on the terminal. Navigate the terminal The handheld terminal has three unlabeled buttons: the signed-in user’s initials open More, the house opens Overview and the receipt opens Checks, subject to permissions. iPad keeps its configured navigation destinations. In Checks, the selector offers All checks and available floor plans; selecting a radio option changes the view immediately. Drag the floor plan when it extends beyond the screen. Overview contains collapsible cards for permitted availability, orders and tables. The full list supports item search; Not provided means availability was not supplied, not that an item is available. Refresh retries a failed read. These views change neither the assigned checkout mode nor printing profiles. The bar stays above Android navigation and hides while typing. Inside a sale, Menu/Check/Actions and the return to checks retain their own controls.

articles.title: POS navigation, appearance and shortcuts
articles.description: Open More/Plus on the POS. Destinations are filtered by role and device capabilities.
articles.body: Open More/Plus on the POS. Destinations are filtered by role and device capabilities. Select the table again after changing restaurants On a compatible updated POS, changing restaurants resets only the screen selections: table, active check context and selected seat. Orders and checks already saved remain in their original restaurant with their contents and payment; this change does not delete, transfer or resend them. In the new restaurant, select the intended table or check again and verify the context before adding or sending food. Do not rely on the selection shown before the change. This protection requires the compatible POS; it does not prove that a particular device has been updated. Distinguish orders from a previous table service On a compatible updated POS, with orders.manage, an older manual order that is still active remains separately visible by its number and date. Tap it to view its own lines and total in Menu without attaching it to the table’s current occupancy. An absent or different session cannot open the next party’s table service. QR orders also retain their individual numbers and payments. Manual kitchen sends within one confirmed current session remain grouped in that session’s usual check. A table may therefore have an empty current session and older outstanding orders: these are not the same check. Opening the view never merges, closes, archives or settles anything. Eligible saved-order actions remain limited to its number and the required permissions. If the session changes while loading, return to Orders or reopen the current table; do not recreate the order or retry a payment to bypass the error. Updating the API alone does not update the installed POS. Distinguish the selected order from the table check With orders.manage, an active QR or web order opens Menu with its own saved check on the right on tablets. The catalogue remains browsable without changing saved lines or a local draft. Actions manages only that order; Guest shows its own contact. View table separately opens the verified current session and, when needed, a bill choice. The frame, tabs and cards use the standard Menu presentation without an extra back toolbar. Orders in the main navigation returns to the list. Refresh and order statuses are in Actions. A failed read shows Retry rather than an empty basket. Historical records and view-only roles remain read-only. See the full workflow. Retry an unconfirmed cash-drawer read This diagnostic needs compatible POS and API versions; this guide does not confirm installation. A failed read does not mean that no drawer is open. The message may identify a shift or sign-in to check, device authorization needing review, an installation that does not match the open shift, or temporarily unavailable verification. Ask a manager about access refusals; Retry reads the state without repairing or moving a relationship. New cash operations stay unavailable until the state is confirmed. Preserve pending operations and local data. See cash-read recovery. Terminal deposit remains separate. Check report currency Restaurant information and the sales report use the saved currency returned by the API, not a POS-forced dollar. The report refuses to load if currency is missing or the information belongs to another restaurant. Check the current restaurant and its settings, then refresh; do not manually change the symbol to reconcile amounts. Distinguish reports, cash and card deposits On a tablet, More → Reports opens Cash drawer balance when your role permits, otherwise permitted Sales or Terminal deposits. The left rail contains only accessible sections. Choosing Cash movements replaces the content within this workspace without stacking another Reports page. Cash movements shows the session loaded on this device with date, type, amount and reason; it is not a history of other sessions. On a phone, Reports remains a destination list. Opening or refreshing a report closes nothing. Closing physical cash and the terminal’s Close and deposit remain separate actions even when both belong to the same end-of-day procedure. If the restaurant, sign-in or terminal changes, reopen confirmation in the correct context. Find operational workspaces Use Home shortcuts or More for Analytics, Kitchen, Staff and Settings. Orders contains live and historical order workflows. Transactions is separate and lists completed payments for staff with payments.view or payments.manage; on a compact terminal it is in More. Reports in More contains Verifone Terminal deposits for payment managers (payments.manage). A missing destination can reflect permission or activation, so check the account/profile before reinstalling. Customize the device In Settings choose Appearance and Shortcuts to adjust supported theme/layout and home actions. Hardware and Checkout have separate panels. Review the installed version in account/settings when reporting a problem; do not share a PIN or activation code. Handle connectivity problems Check Internet, the selected restaurant/device and explicit connection status. Refresh before repeating a save, kitchen send or payment. A cloud POS does not guarantee offline ordering, payment or printing; an unknown state must be reconciled before another action. Printing profiles are shared, but hardware assignments are per POS installation. After reinstalling, select the existing profile in Hardware → Printers. If waiting documents are reported, review read-only history before confirming; see printer assignments. Browse handheld terminal pages On the handheld terminal, the initials at the lower left open More; they come from the signed-in user’s name. The house opens the operational Overview and the receipt opens Checks. Orders, Transactions, Hardware, Appearance and Reports remain in More according to permissions; the role and assigned mode appear when available. The mode card opens its settings only with the corresponding permission. In Library, the filter opens Items, Combos or Discounts and categories remain above the items. Headers and back controls fit the terminal width. Tablets retain their own navigation and columns. The three targets stay above Android system buttons; while typing, the bar hides and actions move with the keyboard. Inside a sale, use Menu/Check/Actions and the explicit return to checks. View terminal overview and item availability On a handheld terminal, tap the house to open Overview. The restaurant name and collapsible cards show the availability, new/in-kitchen/ready orders and table state allowed by your role. Open View all item availability to search active items in menus available at the POS. The list uses the same catalogue as POS order entry; it does not depend on a general menu state separate from its POS availability. States are Available, Low stock, Unavailable or Not provided; a quantity appears only when supplied. Unknown availability does not mean available. Hidden groups, their descendants and combo-only components are excluded. Refresh reloads the reads; a failure displays a message and retry. Card buttons open orders or checks according to permissions. Overview reads data without changing stock or orders.

articles.title: Restaurant profile, languages and hours
articles.description: Open Settings for the selected restaurant. Confirm its name before saving changes.
articles.body: Open Settings for the selected restaurant. Confirm its name before saving changes. Check shared POS settings before saving A device assigned to a mode uses that shared mode’s service settings, not a second local iPad policy. Confirm the selected restaurant and assigned mode. The updated API merges edits to different POS-policy fields and rejects conflicting edits to the same field. In Admin, retain a rejected draft for review, then use Reload saved settings and confirm discarding it before reapplying the intended change. Do not repeatedly submit an outdated policy. Update the API before Admin and POS; older clients without the merge contract retain their legacy save behavior and must not edit shared settings during rollout. Restaurant identity, address, hours and customer records are not changed by a POS-mode edit. See shared mode recovery. Check the restaurant before configuring POS methods In Settings → Fulfillment → Point of sale → Manage by location, verify the restaurant before editing methods or optional customer information. These shared POS settings do not change its identity, address or customer database. Done prepares the draft; Save persists the whole configuration. An unsupported option or incomplete server confirmation leaves it unconfirmed: keep the draft and resolve the error. See POS method settings. Review the by-weight authorization ceiling For online by-weight orders, open Settings → Payments & VAT with settings.edit. Set Weight hold buffer % from 0 to 100 and save; the default for new restaurants is 20. A failed save keeps the draft. Zero still authorizes the estimate. Only the weight-priced subtotal gets a margin: 100 weighted + 50 fixed at 20% authorizes 170; delivery has no extra margin. Checkout shows the estimate, temporary ceiling and Confirm and authorize, in the restaurant theme. A changed ceiling requires customer review and another confirmation before payment; unknown policy blocks authorization. Existing reviewed checkouts and holds keep their ceiling. Staff confirm measured weights before capture and progression; excess beyond the hold is flagged for a separate payment, never automatically charged. Cash/pay-later makes no hold promise. Requires a configured authorize/capture provider, with partial capture, release and expiry validated before production. This neither changes the catering deposit/balance policy nor enables new-card saving with a CST weighted hold. Edit restaurant information In general settings update the displayed name, description, contact information and address fields available to your role. In Branding update logo and brand assets. Save and verify the guest-facing result; Website may have its own published design overrides. Set supported languages In Languages choose the restaurant languages and default language offered by the form. Translate catalog names and public website content separately. Changing the interface language alone does not translate every item or customer message. Maintain opening hours In Opening hours edit each day and its time ranges, including closed days. Check the restaurant time zone, calendar exceptions and separate pickup/delivery schedules. Save, then verify the next offered fulfillment slot without placing a real order. Access the new controls The entry sign-in invitation is now a published website order-journey preference. Order without an account remains available; this setting does not replace mandatory phone verification or payment/delivery validation. Google/Geoapify consumption and limits are separately available in Usage and quotas. Staff contact details and courier destination Staff contact details are managed in Admin → Staff → employee → Edit contact details. The restaurant-scoped name and phone are used for courier assignment and upcoming delivery reminders; the sign-in email remains read-only. Couriers can save a default final destination or link it to their home address. New routes propose that destination and allow an explicit override or removal. It is the courier’s end-of-route destination, separate from the customer’s delivery address. Existing populated routes and completed delivery snapshots keep their saved data. See staff profiles for saving, permissions and recovery. POS code at staff activation Staff activation checks the permissions assigned in this restaurant, including custom roles: orders.manage or payments.manage requires a private POS code. Read-only couriers and kitchen-only roles do not need one. Existing unused invitation links apply the same current rule. Changing a role label, courier address or route destination does not grant POS permissions. See activation and recovery. Control weekly ordering manually Weekly batch restaurants can choose Manual opening under Settings → Ordering & delivery → Orders & availability, with settings.edit. Save, then explicitly open or pause online orders using the pause control. Automatic opening/cutoff times do not control intake in this mode. Delivery days/windows, the restaurant timezone, preparation and stock rules remain in effect; existing orders are untouched. The website stays browsable during a pause. Active temporary test access must be disabled before reopening publicly. See the fulfillment settings guide for the complete procedure.

articles.title: Service modes and device profiles
articles.description: Choose between Table Mode (floor plan with table assignments) and Counter Mode (no tables, pickup-style service).
articles.body: Admin → Settings → Devices → Modes Choose a mode profile Review the available mode profiles and select the one intended for the POS device. Check enabled modules and the device assignment before use. Configure table and counter behavior Review seating, covers, service courses, kitchen sending and return-to-menu behavior in the corresponding POS settings. Save and verify on the intended device. Keep fulfillment independent Configure the restaurant's fulfillment methods and prompt separately from the table layout and device mode profile. The whole-check method determines its overall service; an item choice is a preparation exception and does not create a separate delivery. Review whole-check and item choices before changing a sale. A payment does not hide an order from Orders → All or automatically mark its preparation complete. Mode selection and any customer prompt precede items in a new onsite sale. The table/check is chosen only at Send/Continue; cancellation preserves the source. See whole-check fulfillment. Private guest context is staff-only, never a public checkout answer or notification variable. Save a shared mode and recover a conflict A mode is shared by all assigned devices. Save requires the updated API’s conflict-safe settings capability. Independent edits to different fields can merge; a competing edit to the same field is rejected and your draft remains visible. Do not repeatedly save that stale draft. Choose Reload saved settings, confirm discarding the unsaved draft, then review the latest policy and apply only the intended edit. The same recovery applies when the server cannot confirm the save. A read-only or older-API screen cannot enable the new save contract. The updated POS refreshes the shared policy in the foreground about every 30 seconds, on resume, navigation and after an action; an active payment, send or item edit defers application until its safe completion. This refresh never repeats the action. Confirm the intended device assignment and effective modules before serving. Review and edit Modes in Admin In Settings → Device management → Modes, search, sort by name or assigned-device count, and change the page size. Select a mode name or its options button to open its side panel without leaving the list. Review the assigned devices, then Manage opens the full-screen editor. Rename stages the new name; Save explicitly persists it. Creating a mode or deleting selected modes is also staged until Save. Closing a panel retains the list draft; leaving with changes asks whether to discard. A save error retains the draft. Only settings-edit permission can mutate profiles; read-only staff can inspect the panel. An unavailable device is reported rather than silently reassigned. Creation dates show a dash because the current API does not supply mode creation dates. Restaurant defaults remain separately accessible and are not a physical device profile. Confirm or undo deletion from the mode editor With settings-edit permission, open an existing mode through Manage and choose Delete mode, then confirm. This only stages the removal: the original mode name stays in the header and Deletion pending explains the next step. Save confirms the deletion and returns to the Modes list only after the server confirms the saved policy. Undo deletion restores the complete edited profile, including its unsaved changes, so you can continue editing; it does not send a request. A failed, conflicting or unconfirmed save keeps the pending deletion visible. Follow the shared-mode save recovery before retrying a stale draft; accepting Reload saved settings discards both that draft and its undo snapshot. A mode already absent when the editor loads is reported as missing, not as a pending local deletion. Do not delete a working profile to test this flow: assigned devices fall back to restaurant defaults after the removal is saved. Return home after sending and start a fresh sale In the effective device mode, open Open checks, enable Use on this mode and Use Open Tickets as the home screen, then Save. Refresh settings on the POS. After a confirmed Send, a table check returns to the floor plan and a named check returns to open checks. Returning to Menu opens a separate empty sale; it does not reopen or erase the sent check. Reopen the saved check from its table or open-check list to add more dishes. The original customer, bill and kitchen batches remain there. Continue/Send and stay retains the current check. Failed sending or a changed restaurant, permission or editor context does not detach the source. Another unsent counter basket is not cleared. With the home setting disabled this new-sale handoff is not applied. All saved orders remain tracked on POS and Admin; payment, preparation and check closure stay independent.

articles.title: Order processing and kitchen workflow
articles.description: Configure auto-kitchen, order approval, rush mode, tips, scheduled orders, and pickup prep time.
articles.body: Admin → Settings → Restaurant → Processing / Workflow Review order acceptance Choose the restaurant’s acceptance policy and review which orders require staff approval. Paid and accepted are distinct statuses; unpaid online orders requiring payment are not sent as paid POS orders. Configure kitchen progression Review automatic/manual kitchen sending and preparation progression. Test one intended order in the agreed test environment and verify its kitchen ticket. Set preparation timing Set the preparation delay/start policy and splitting behavior in the offered controls. Check minute-level values and timezone; guest scheduling is validated by the API. Verify saved settings Save changes, reopen the settings and verify the POS behavior for each intended order type. The response must confirm the fields you changed, including kitchen sending and prepayment. A successful HTTP response with missing or old values is not a confirmed save: the editor keeps your draft and displays the save error. Correct or reload the settings before expecting other devices to use them; do not repeat an order or payment to test a settings save. Choose a stage attachment In Admin, open Settings → Restaurant → Order workflow and the required pickup or delivery stage. With Notify customer enabled, choose the message type, an approved Meta photo/PDF model and its attachment: a fixed file, or that order’s receipt for a PDF. Choose the sending time and save the workflow. Manual stage entry or its configured event uses this binding. Selecting a file changes neither progression, payment rules nor delivery eligibility. Correct an incompatible or missing model/file before relying on delivery. The model library and creation controls are in Settings → Communications → WhatsApp. WhatsApp template image Approved WhatsApp Utility templates with a photo automatically use the image retrieved from Meta when no local file was selected. The preview displays that image; a change before a manual send requires another review. Retrieval failure blocks sending without a text-only fallback. Configure or refresh the template in Settings → Communications → WhatsApp. See the WhatsApp guide.

articles.title: POS access, devices and shifts
articles.description: Admin → Staff → POS access / Shift reports
articles.body: Admin → Staff → POS access / Shift reports Record your hours without signing into the POS This flow needs the updated POS version and its matching API deployed before installation. This guide does not confirm availability on your installed device. 1. On Sign in on an already enrolled device, tap Show hours. In Time tracking, enter your complete personal 4–6-digit passcode, then confirm it. Checking this status neither starts a shift nor signs you into the POS. Closing returns to PIN sign-in. 2. If no shift is active, tap Clock in to start explicitly. Wait for server confirmation. The active screen shows your actual account role, not an invented job or scheduled shift. 3. During an active shift, Add notes opens an optional note for your employer, limited to 500 characters. Save applies the note to this shift; closing without saving does not apply it. 4. Tap End shift to record your departure. An open cash drawer on the period’s original POS prevents completion: ask an authorized manager to finish its report and close cash on that device, then retry. This flow does not close the drawer or start a Verifone deposit. 5. Once confirmed, Clocked out shows only your relevant shift, its server-recorded dates/times and duration. Recorded hours are not a payroll calculation; missing data does not establish a work schedule. Continue to FoodyPOS returns to the PIN screen without automatically signing into sales. After rejection, check the personal code and device authorization with a manager. If an action’s result is uncertain, use Refresh hours to verify status before retrying; do not assume failure or create a second clocking event. If unavailable, have the device and API version checked. Never share your passcode or notes with the assistant. Check the shift-to-device access relationship This protection requires the compatible API to be deployed; this guide does not confirm installation. PIN sign-in that resumes an existing shift preserves that interval, its start time and its original device authorization. Signing in on another POS or renewing an authorization transfers neither that shift nor its cash drawer. If the original authorization can no longer be verified in the restaurant, sales sign-in is refused without creating a replacement shift. Depending on the POS version, the displayed error may remain generic. Ask a manager to have support verify the historical relationship. Show hours remains a separate flow for checking your own status; a successful read neither repairs the relationship nor authorizes cash closure. If that read also fails, preserve the state and ask for assistance. Do not clear local data, re-enroll the device or create a new shift to bypass the refusal. Do not blindly change hours or device assignments: selecting another authorization can hide a different cash journal. A database error does not prove that a reference is missing. Repair must be verified and approved separately while preserving recorded hours, pending operations and original journals. It never automatically closes cash or starts a Verifone deposit. Retry an unconfirmed cash-drawer read This diagnostic needs compatible POS and API versions; this guide does not confirm installation. A failed read does not mean that no drawer is open. The message may identify a shift or sign-in to check, device authorization needing review, an installation that does not match the open shift, or temporarily unavailable verification. Ask a manager about access refusals; Retry reads the state without repairing or moving a relationship. New cash operations stay unavailable until the state is confirmed. Preserve pending operations and local data. See cash-read recovery. Terminal deposit remains separate. Finish the report before signing out Sign out in navigation and End shift in More use the same check, scoped to the active POS and restaurant. With orders.manage or payments.manage, Foody checks the report before offering to end the shift. An open drawer, even with no sale or movement, or an unconfirmed local cash operation shows Cash drawer report pending. Cancel changes nothing. Finish report opens More → Reports → Cash drawer balance; it does not close the drawer, use expected cash as a physical count, or sign you out. Resume uncertain operations using their existing identity. To close, an operator with orders.manage physically counts the cash present and confirms closure. Then request sign-out again and confirm End shift to return to PIN while keeping the device enrolled. Closing cash alone does not automatically end your staff shift. Without report permissions, the server still checks the drawer: if open, ask an authorized manager; the message does not grant report access. If verification fails, the session stays open: check the connection and Retry without clearing local data. The server also rechecks after confirmation in case a drawer opened in the meantime. The Verifone card deposit stays separate and explicit: neither this message nor sign-out starts it. Revoked or expired access can require a security sign-out; this neither counts nor closes cash and does not erase recovery journals. Verify a shift end with an uncertain response On a compatible POS, if the shift-end confirmation is not received, keep the same sign-in and restaurant, then explicitly choose Retry. Foody rereads your current period without sending another end request during this verification. It returns to PIN only when the read confirms no active period, the same POS context is still current and no cash operation is pending. If a period is still active, you stay signed in: cash is checked again and another explicit end confirmation is required. A failed or unconfirmed read keeps you signed in and offers Retry. Resolve any pending cash operation first using its existing identity; do not clear local data. Cancel keeps you signed in but does not undo a shift end already saved. Changing sign-in or restaurant invalidates the in-flight verification. This check does not count cash, close the drawer or start a Verifone deposit. It does not certify physical testing on your device. Distinguish reports, cash and card deposits On a tablet, More → Reports opens Cash drawer balance when your role permits, otherwise permitted Sales or Terminal deposits. The left rail contains only accessible sections. Choosing Cash movements replaces the content within this workspace without stacking another Reports page. Cash movements shows the session loaded on this device with date, type, amount and reason; it is not a history of other sessions. On a phone, Reports remains a destination list. Opening or refreshing a report closes nothing. Closing physical cash and the terminal’s Close and deposit remain separate actions even when both belong to the same end-of-day procedure. Activate a POS device Review the restaurant device list and follow the device setup pairing flow. Confirm the device belongs to the intended restaurant before authorizing access. Use a personal POS code After activation, use the configured employee POS code. End your service or switch employee using the POS controls instead of sharing a manager session. Review shift reports Choose the report period and employee/device filters, then inspect recorded start/end times. A missing end time must be investigated rather than assumed closed. Finish a shift with an open cash drawer If End shift says the cash drawer is open, open More → Reports → Cash drawer balance on the same enrolled POS. Resolve any pending cash operation, count the physical cash and close that device's cash session before trying End shift again. The shift is not ended by a Verifone card-batch deposit, and ending a shift does not itself transmit a card batch. If the count or payment result is uncertain, reconcile it with an authorized manager instead of forcing a sign-out or taking a second payment. Read the cash-drawer report on a handheld More → Reports → Cash drawer uses a vertical page on a handheld terminal. Amounts, sessions, permissions and confirmations retain their existing behavior. Colors and insets do not turn a report into a drawer closure or a card deposit.

articles.title: Employees and invitations
articles.description: Add employees, review invitation delivery and assign restaurant roles.
articles.body: Admin → Staff → Employees Availability and access Requires staff management permission for invitations and changes. Invite an employee Enter the name, email, optional phone and restaurant role, then submit. Read the invitation delivery result separately from employee creation. Resend an invitation Open Staff → Employees, choose the existing member and use Resend setup invitation. Check the email delivery result and ask the member to use only the newest email. This creates a new one-time link for the same member and restaurant; it does not require deleting or adding the employee again. An unused, unexpired link can already be reopened after failed activation, and uses the current role permissions. If activation succeeded, the member can sign in or recover their password instead. Review and remove access Review role, account status and POS code configuration. Not required for this role means the current restaurant permissions do not require a POS code at activation; it is not an unfinished activation. Not configured applies to a role that requires a code. Use removal only for the intended employee; owner controls remain protected. Edit contact details and courier defaults In Staff, open an employee then Edit contact details. With staff management permission, edit the name, phone and Home address, then Save. These contact details belong to this establishment; the sign-in email is read-only and account credentials, roles and other establishments are unchanged. The owner’s contact details can also be edited. For a courier, set Default final destination or choose Same as home address. The linked choice follows later saved home-address edits; an empty home address cannot be used. Leave the final destination empty for no default. New routes copy this destination automatically, including the first real plan from an empty courier placeholder. You can override or clear the destination for one route while planning it. Existing routes with deliveries retain their saved destination. Changes to a courier’s name or phone update upcoming delivery reminders in this establishment, while completed orders keep their historical snapshot. Address suggestions may help complete a street or city; route planning verifies the destination before routing. An unavailable suggestion service does not erase input. Saving is explicit; errors retain the form, and closing a changed form asks whether to discard. Users with staff viewing permission can inspect the profile but cannot edit it. Recover a delivery after a test departure To check newly activated courier access, view an assigned route without recording a departure or delivery. Starting courier mode marks assigned orders Out for delivery. If this was a test departure, a user with order-management permission can open Orders → Deliveries, select the date and choose Undo departure while no arrival, delivery or skipped stop has been recorded. Out for delivery orders return to In preparation; the route returns to draft and can be unassigned and reallocated. This is a delivery correction, not a new order, refund or reprint. Payments and previously sent messages are preserved. See the dispatch procedure. Read staff on the mobile POS The POS Staff page remains read-only, with a centered header, Back and Refresh on mobile. Invitations and permission edits still belong to an authorized account in Admin.

articles.title: Roles and permissions
articles.description: Admin → Staff → Roles and permissions
articles.body: Admin → Staff → Roles and permissions Availability and access Requires role-management permission; restaurant scope always applies. Create a role Open the role library, create a named role and select the required permissions. Save before assigning employees. Assign and verify Assign the role from the employee profile. Verify the permitted pages and actions with that employee; menu visibility alone is not proof of authorization. The Verifone Terminal deposits screen and its batch-changing actions require payments.manage; payments.view is not enough. Change or retire a role Review assigned employees before changing permissions or deleting a role. Respect protected system/owner roles and check resulting access after saving. Access the new controls Settings → Usage and quotas displays this restaurant’s Google/Geoapify allowances and usage with settings view/edit permission. Fallback credits and deliveries submitted for optimization are distinct from request counts. Foody adjusts limits without resetting counters. See limits and renewal. POS code at staff activation Staff activation checks the permissions assigned in this restaurant, including custom roles: orders.manage or payments.manage requires a private POS code. Read-only couriers and kitchen-only roles do not need one. Existing unused invitation links apply the same current rule. Changing a role label, courier address or route destination does not grant POS permissions. See activation and recovery.

articles.title: Floor plans, tables and QR codes
articles.description: Create your dining room layout in FoodyAdmin and use it to manage tables in FoodyPOS.
articles.body: Admin → Settings → Restaurant → Floor plans / Table QR Create a floor plan Create a named floor plan, add the required tables and arrange their position, shape and capacity using the editor. Save before opening it on the POS. Organize service sections Review restaurant sections and table assignments. Keep table identities stable when rearranging a plan; moving a drawing is different from moving a financial check. Prepare table QR cards Open table QR settings, select the intended table and customize the available card style/text. Download or print the offered output and scan it to verify restaurant and table. Use the live table view Select the correct floor plan on the POS and inspect table status before opening a check. An already open table resumes its current session without asking for covers again. Its usual Menu workspace shows the existing check and permitted actions; separated financial bills still require their own selection. Only a free table starting a new service requests covers according to the assigned mode. Reopening does not alter existing covers, seats, orders or payments. If the latest table/check read fails or its session changes, retry the read rather than opening a replacement service. Review covers/seats separately and confirm the saved check before payment or transfer. Selecting a table after changing a draft's fulfillment method is not a bill move or merge. A table with an existing financial check refuses and cancels that pending transfer, keeping the source draft intact; see changing a draft's service. Several QR guests keep distinct order IDs and payments even when their food appears in the same table session. Verify a saved layout after an update After arranging tables, save the plan explicitly, reopen it in Admin and compare its positions, dimensions and rotations on the POS. The updated API preserves authored version-2 geometry during startup; only old formats are normalized. This correction prevents a restart from resizing a saved custom layout, but cannot reconstruct dimensions or angles already overwritten by an older version. If tables unexpectedly overlap, keep a screenshot and have the installed API version checked before saving another arrangement. Restore the intended drawing explicitly after the correction, or have an authorized operator review an available backup; do not assume an automatic restoration. Keep table identities and active checks intact: moving a drawing is not closing a service, transferring a bill or merging QR orders. Avoid saving from an old editor tab after another person has changed the plan. Track service duration and state The duration on the floor plan and checks list starts with the table session, not the most recently added dish. Seating guests without entering covers also starts service; an open table is not free merely because its cover count is absent. Reopening the check, sending another batch or receiving a QR order in the same session does not restart the duration. QR guests retain separate orders and payments. Scanning a QR alone does not prove occupancy. Pickup and delivery orders must not occupy a table. Kitchen, payment and checkout-request states remain distinct from this duration. After confirmed closure, cached orders must not revive the old service; a new occupation has its own session. If a read fails, refresh and verify server state before closing or reseating the table. Use Checks on mobile On the updated terminal, the bottom receipt icon opens Checks. Tap the view selector to choose All checks or a floor plan in the same radio sheet. All checks combines accessible named checks and open tables; choosing a floor returns to its tables. Search opens the searchable check list. Restaurant positions, shapes and states remain authoritative; drag the plan to reach off-screen tables without editing its geometry. Open a free table and, if prompted, choose the guest count or No covers; Back cancels the choice. The + button offers authorized sales and tools, including Actions for staff filters, To do and Refresh. Permissions and settings continue to limit destinations. Neither an offering nor an animation releases a real table without server confirmation. The sheet also reserves space above Android system buttons so its last option remains visible and reachable. Scroll the list when all floors do not fit the available height.

articles.title: Create and print table QR cards
articles.description: Open Restaurant → Table QR, then Customize or Print.
articles.body: Open Restaurant → Table QR, then Customize or Print. Customize the QR card Select a card layout, text, logo/image and colors, then adjust the available typography roles: font, weight, case, size, letter spacing and color. Check Hebrew glyph support and contrast. QR readability takes priority over decoration. Print and verify table destinations Choose the intended tables and print/export options. Scan a sample from the actual printed size and verify restaurant/table before placing it in service. Replaced or expired signed links require refreshed cards; do not manually edit encoded IDs/signatures.

articles.title: Table access, status and assistance
articles.description: Open Staff → Table service to assign access. Table status and assistance are configured under Settings.
articles.body: Open Staff → Table service to assign access. Table status and assistance are configured under Settings. Assign rooms, sections and tables Choose free, collaborative or strict assignment mode, read its displayed access rule, then modify an eligible staff member’s assignment. Select rooms, sections or specific tables and review the resulting covered-table count. Staff with unrestricted table access remain explicitly identified. Maintain table state Review the available status labels and table/session controls. An occupied table can have multiple bills: check the active session and covers before seating, moving or closing. Changing a visual status is not proof that a bill was paid. Changing an unsent draft's fulfillment method does not move or merge an existing bill or replace its lifecycle. Choosing a table with a financial check cancels the pending draft transfer and leaves the source intact; follow the draft-service procedure. Resume the correct table service On a compatible updated POS, opening an occupied table resumes only its confirmed current session without restarting its service or asking for its covers again. Its timer is not reset. Configured cover prompts still apply when starting a new occupancy. If the table closes or changes session while loading or transferring a draft, navigation into the old context stops. Return to the floor plan and reopen the current table; do not force food onto the next party’s service. Verify an unconfirmed transfer before sending an order again. Older outstanding orders remain separate and viewable by number in Orders. Opening the table neither settles nor closes those older orders. After changing restaurants, select the table again in the current context. The previous screen selection is cleared; saved checks are neither moved nor deleted. Verify table thresholds and closure In table-status settings, review indicators, the in-service color and yellow/red thresholds in minutes, then save. These are restaurant-wide settings: changing POS mode does not create separate thresholds. If the server does not confirm changed fields, the draft remains with a save error; reload or correct it before relying on the new colors. A color change neither collects money nor closes a table. Closure refuses outstanding orders; a fully refunded order is no longer an active debt. The table and its QR sessions close together or remain unchanged on failure. If service changed while creating an order, reopen the table instead of forcing the old context. This does not perform terminal deposit or bank settlement. Configure assistance requests In Table assistance enable the supported requests and staff notifications appropriate to service. Check the assigned staff/device recipients. On the service screen acknowledge or resolve the request after attending the guest; an assistance request does not create a payment. Find service tools on mobile In Checks on the updated terminal, the radio selector connects All checks with available floor plans. Open + then Actions for the staff filter, To do and Refresh. Assignment restrictions and permissions still limit accessible tables and checks. The plan can pan on screen; neither panning nor switching views saves new geometry, assigns staff or releases a table. The active user’s name supplies the initials at the lower left; that button opens More without changing service assignment.

articles.title: Catering and chain entry pages
articles.description: Select the catering or chain order-entry page in Website. The service catalog and branch activation are managed separately.
articles.body: Select the catering or chain order-entry page in Website. The service catalog and branch activation are managed separately. Customize catering presentation Edit the page heading, introduction, service subtitles and available layout options. An empty override inherits the original service text; use reset to restore inheritance. Only active services can be presented. Confirm the service’s separate availability and quote settings. Customize branch selection Edit branch-selector copy in French, Hebrew and English and the available appearance options. Check that the chain page links to the intended active branch and ordering mode. Publishing a design does not grant a branch new permissions, a menu or payment credentials.

articles.title: Checkout, confirmation and digital receipt design
articles.description: In Website open the order journey screens. Their appearance is separate from payment-provider configuration.
articles.body: In Website open the order journey screens. Their appearance is separate from payment-provider configuration. Preview checkout and confirmation Select checkout then confirmation, adjust available colors and text, and inspect mobile readability. Required customer, fulfillment and payment fields come from restaurant policy. A preview does not place an order or verify a live payment connection. Set receipt content and actions On the receipt screen set localized title/message and compact or comfortable layout.
